guide.summary: Put 得 or 不 between a verb and its result or direction to say whether the result can be reached: 看得懂 'can understand (by reading)', 看不懂 'cannot'. It is about being able to manage it, not about permission. When English says 'can't' and the reason is that you would fail (too hard, too far, too many, too expensive), Chinese uses Verb + 不 + Result, not 不能.

subs.label: V得R / V不R with a result
subs.focus: Force the learner to put 得 or 不 between verb and result (看不懂, 听不见, 找不到, 做不完, 买得到) and to pick the right result word; also 看不懂 (cannot) vs 没看懂 (did not, one occasion). Classic mistakes: 不能看懂, 不看懂, 没看得懂, 不 before the verb.

subs.label: V得/不 + direction (进不去, 想不起来)
subs.focus: Force 得 or 不 between verb and direction word (进不去, 回不来, 爬不上去, 搬不进去, 站不起来), with 来 or 去 chosen by the speaker's position, plus figurative 想不起来 'cannot recall'. Classic mistakes: 不能进去 for inability, 不 in the wrong slot (进去不, 想起不来), wrong direction word.

subs.label: Set forms: 来不及, 买不起, 吃不下, 对不起
subs.focus: Force the complement with the right built-in meaning: 起 = afford, 下 = room for, 及 = in time, plus frozen 对不起. Give a reason clause (too expensive, too full, too late) that allows only one. Classic mistakes: 不能买 for 'cannot afford', 买不到 vs 买不起, 吃不完 where the cue says no room.

subs.label: V不了 / V得了 (liǎo)
subs.focus: Force V不了 / V得了 (了 read liǎo) when there is no specific result word: the action cannot happen at all (去不了, 来不了, 忘不了, 受不了) or there is too much to finish (吃不了, 喝不了). Classic mistakes: 去不了 (cannot go) confused with 不去了 (not going any more); bare 不 instead of 不了.

subs.label: Unable (V不R) vs not allowed (不能 V)
subs.focus: Force a choice between 不能 + verb (not permitted, should not: 不能进去, 不能拿走) and V不R (unable: 进不去, 拿不动). Every item needs a reason clause that fixes one reading: a rule or instruction vs a physical or practical obstacle. Classic mistake: 不能 for every English 'can't'.

subs.label: Potential vs degree: 写不好 / 写得不好
subs.focus: Force 'cannot do it well' (potential: 写不好, question 写得好写不好, no 很) vs 'does it badly / well' (degree: 写得不好, 写得很好, question 写得好不好); cue and context must fix one reading. Classic mistakes: 写得不好 for 'can't write it well', 很 inside a potential form (看得很懂), mixed question shapes.

subs.label: Where the object goes
subs.focus: The learner must place the object after the whole verb + 得/不 + complement unit (听不懂他的话) or in front as a topic (他的话我听不懂), and never use 把 with a potential complement. Classic mistakes: object between verb and complement (听他的话不懂), 把这本书看不懂, and 了 placed before the object (想不起来了他的名字).

subs.label: Asking: 吗, V得R V不R, V不V得R
subs.focus: The learner must form a question with 吗 (听得见吗), with the full positive + negative pair (听得见听不见) or with the colloquial V不V得R (听不听得见), and answer by repeating the potential form (听得见 / 听不见). Classic mistakes: 听得见不见, 听得不得见, adding 吗 to an A-not-A question, answering with 是 or 不是.

rules.rule: To say a result can or cannot be reached, put 得 (can) or 不 (cannot) between the verb and its result word. Nothing else goes in between.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 / 不 + Result (+ Object)

examples.zh: 他说话太快，我听不懂。
examples.py: tā shuō huà tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
examples.en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand him.

examples.zh: 你声音太小，我听不见。
examples.py: nǐ shēng yīn tài xiǎo wǒ tīng bù jiàn
examples.en: Your voice is too quiet; I can't hear you.

examples.zh: 这么多作业，我今天做不完。
examples.py: zhè me duō zuò yè wǒ jīn tiān zuò bù wán
examples.en: With this much homework, I can't finish it today.

examples.zh: 别担心，现在去还买得到票。
examples.py: bié dān xīn xiàn zài qù hái mǎi de dào piào
examples.en: Don't worry, if we go now we can still get tickets.

rules.note: The negative form is much more common than the positive. The positive V得R shows up mostly in questions, in answers to them, and when reassuring or contradicting someone (often with 还 or 也).

rules.rule: V不R means 'cannot manage it'. 没 + VR means 'did not manage it' on one past occasion. Do not put 没 or 不 in front of a potential form.
rules.pattern: Verb + 不 + Result (cannot)  /  没 + Verb + Result (did not)

examples.zh: 这本书太难了，我看不懂。
examples.py: zhè běn shū tài nán le wǒ kàn bù dǒng
examples.en: This book is too hard; I can't understand it.

examples.zh: 昨天的电影我没看懂。
examples.py: zuó tiān de diàn yǐng wǒ méi kàn dǒng
examples.en: I didn't understand yesterday's film.

examples.zh: 我找了半天，还是找不到。
examples.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shì zhǎo bù dào
examples.en: I've looked for ages and still can't find it.

rules.note: For a past situation both can be right with different meanings: 昨天我找不到手机 (I was unable to find it) and 昨天我没找到手机 (I didn't find it). The potential form itself never takes 了 to mark the past.

rules.rule: Directional complements work the same way: 得 or 不 goes right after the verb, before the direction word(s). 来 means toward the speaker, 去 means away.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 / 不 + direction (上 / 下 / 进 / 出 / 回 / 起) + 来 / 去

examples.zh: 人太多了，我们进不去。
examples.py: rén tài duō le wǒ men jìn bù qù
examples.en: There are too many people; we can't get in.

examples.zh: 这张桌子太大了，搬不进去。
examples.py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi tài dà le bān bù jìn qù
examples.en: This table is too big; it can't be carried in.

examples.zh: 他的名字我想不起来了。
examples.py: tā de míng zi wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
examples.en: I can't remember his name any more.

examples.zh: 山这么高，你爬得上去吗？
examples.py: shān zhè me gāo nǐ pá de shàng qù ma
examples.en: The mountain is so high. Can you climb up it?

rules.note: 想不起来 is 'cannot recall something you once knew'; it is not 想不出来 ('cannot think up' an idea or answer).

rules.rule: Some complements have a special meaning only in the potential form: V不起 = cannot afford, V不下 = no room for it (stomach, room, bag).
rules.pattern: Verb + 得 / 不 + 起 (afford)  /  Verb + 得 / 不 + 下 (room)

examples.zh: 这么贵的手机我买不起。
examples.py: zhè me guì de shǒu jī wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
examples.en: I can't afford such an expensive phone.

examples.zh: 我吃饱了，吃不下了。
examples.py: wǒ chī bǎo le chī bù xià le
examples.en: I'm full; I can't eat any more.

examples.zh: 这个房间住得下四个人。
examples.py: zhè ge fáng jiān zhù de xià sì ge rén
examples.en: This room can fit four people.

rules.note: Keep three 'can't buy / can't eat' meanings apart: 买不起 (too expensive) vs 买不到 (none available); 吃不下 (no room, no appetite) vs 吃不完 / 吃不了 (too much food to finish). Other common set forms: 睡不着 (zháo, cannot fall asleep), 走不动 (too tired to walk on), 拿不动 (too heavy to carry).

rules.rule: 来得及 / 来不及 (there is / is not enough time) and 对不起 are fixed expressions: learn them whole. 来得及 and 来不及 can be followed directly by a verb.
rules.pattern: 来得及 / 来不及 (+ Verb phrase)

examples.zh: 别着急，还来得及。
examples.py: bié zháo jí hái lái de jí
examples.en: Don't worry, there's still time.

examples.zh: 现在去机场已经来不及了。
examples.py: xiàn zài qù jī chǎng yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
examples.en: It's already too late to go to the airport now.

examples.zh: 我早上来不及吃早饭。
examples.py: wǒ zǎo shang lái bù jí chī zǎo fàn
examples.en: I don't have time to eat breakfast in the morning.

examples.zh: 对不起，我来晚了。
examples.py: duì bù qǐ wǒ lái wǎn le
examples.en: Sorry I'm late.

rules.rule: With no specific result word, use 了 (liǎo) as the complement: V不了 = the action cannot happen at all, or cannot be finished because there is too much. V得了 is the positive, mostly in questions.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 不了 / 得了 (+ Object)

examples.zh: 我明天有事，去不了。
examples.py: wǒ míng tiān yǒu shì qù bù liǎo
examples.en: I have something on tomorrow; I can't go.

examples.zh: 这么多菜，我们两个人吃不了。
examples.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men liǎng ge rén chī bù liǎo
examples.en: The two of us can't eat this much food.

examples.zh: 今天太热了，我受不了。
examples.py: jīn tiān tài rè le wǒ shòu bù liǎo
examples.en: It's too hot today; I can't stand it.

examples.zh: 你一个人拿得了这么多东西吗？
examples.py: nǐ yī ge rén ná de liǎo zhè me duō dōng xi ma
examples.en: Can you carry this many things by yourself?

rules.note: Do not mix up 去不了 (liǎo: unable to go) and 不去了 (le: have decided not to go after all). A sentence can have both: 我去不了了 (liǎo le) 'I can't go any more'.

rules.rule: 不能 + verb says it is not allowed or should not be done. Verb + 不 + complement says you are unable to manage it, however much you want to.
rules.pattern: 不能 + Verb (not allowed)  /  Verb + 不 + Complement (unable)

examples.zh: 里面在开会，你不能进去。
examples.py: lǐ miàn zài kāi huì nǐ bù néng jìn qù
examples.en: There's a meeting going on inside; you can't go in.

examples.zh: 我没带钥匙，进不去。
examples.py: wǒ méi dài yào shi jìn bù qù
examples.en: I didn't bring my key; I can't get in.

examples.zh: 这是别人的东西，你不能拿走。
examples.py: zhè shì bié rén de dōng xi nǐ bù néng ná zǒu
examples.en: This belongs to someone else; you can't take it away.

examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我拿不动。
examples.py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ ná bù dòng
examples.en: This suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it.

rules.note: 不能 + bare verb can also express inability caused by circumstances (我明天不能来 = 我明天来不了). The firm rule is narrower: with a result or direction word, 'unable' is V不R, and 不能 + VR is normally heard as 'must not' or simply sounds wrong.

rules.rule: In the positive, ability can be said either way: 能 + VR or V得R. Permission is only 可以 / 能 + verb, never a potential complement.
rules.pattern: 能 + Verb + Result  =  Verb + 得 + Result (able)  /  可以 + Verb (allowed)

examples.zh: 你说慢一点儿，我就听得懂。
examples.py: nǐ shuō màn yī diǎn r wǒ jiù tīng de dǒng
examples.en: If you speak a bit more slowly, I can understand.

examples.zh: 我能听懂老师说的话。
examples.py: wǒ néng tīng dǒng lǎo shī shuō de huà
examples.en: I can understand what the teacher says.

examples.zh: 会开完了，你可以进去了。
examples.py: huì kāi wán le nǐ kě yǐ jìn qù le
examples.en: The meeting is over; you may go in now.

rules.note: You will also hear both together (我能听得懂); it is common in speech and not an error, but do not copy the pattern into the negative.

rules.rule: 写得好 alone can mean 'can write it well' or 'writes well'. The negative and the question tell them apart: potential is 写不好 / 写得好写不好, degree is 写得不好 / 写得好不好. Only the degree form takes 很, 非常, 太.
rules.pattern: Verb + 不 + Adj (cannot)  /  Verb + 得 + 不 / 很 + Adj (how it is done)

examples.zh: 这个字太难了，我写不好。
examples.py: zhè ge zì tài nán le wǒ xiě bù hǎo
examples.en: This character is too hard; I can't write it well.

examples.zh: 他的汉字写得很好。
examples.py: tā de hàn zì xiě de hěn hǎo
examples.en: He writes Chinese characters very well.

examples.zh: 这件事我也说不清楚。
examples.py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ yě shuō bù qīng chu
examples.en: I can't explain this matter clearly either.

examples.zh: 他说得不清楚，我没听懂。
examples.py: tā shuō de bù qīng chu wǒ méi tīng dǒng
examples.en: He didn't say it clearly, so I didn't understand.

rules.note: A bare V得Adj statement with no 很 and no context is usually read as potential or as a contrast; a neutral judgment normally has 很 or another degree word.

rules.rule: Verb + 得/不 + complement is one block. The object goes after the whole block, or in front of the subject or verb as a topic. 把 cannot be used with a potential complement.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 / 不 + Complement + Object  /  Object + Subject + Verb + 不 + Complement

examples.zh: 我找不到我的手机。
examples.py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de shǒu jī
examples.en: I can't find my phone.

examples.zh: 我看不清楚黑板上的字。
examples.py: wǒ kàn bù qīng chu hēi bǎn shàng de zì
examples.en: I can't see the words on the blackboard clearly.

examples.zh: 老师的问题我回答不了。
examples.py: lǎo shī de wèn tí wǒ huí dá bù liǎo
examples.en: I can't answer the teacher's question.

examples.zh: 我想不起来他的名字了。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
examples.en: I can't remember his name any more.

rules.note: With a two-syllable direction word the object may also sit before 来 / 去: 想不起他的名字来 is equally correct, and a place object must go there (开不进车库去). Long or definite objects are very often fronted as a topic. Sentence-final 了 comes after the object.

rules.rule: Ask with 吗, or put the full positive and negative forms side by side, or (colloquial, very common) repeat only the verb: V不V得R. Answer by repeating the potential form.
rules.pattern: V得R + 吗  /  V得R + V不R  /  V + 不 + V得R

examples.zh: 你看得见黑板上的字吗？
examples.py: nǐ kàn de jiàn hēi bǎn shàng de zì ma
examples.en: Can you see the words on the blackboard?

examples.zh: 这本书你看得懂看不懂？
examples.py: zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bù dǒng
examples.en: Can you understand this book or not?

examples.zh: 你看不看得懂中文报纸？
examples.py: nǐ kàn bù kàn de dǒng zhōng wén bào zhǐ
examples.en: Can you read Chinese newspapers?

examples.zh: 我们现在去，来得及吗？
examples.py: wǒ men xiàn zài qù lái de jí ma
examples.en: If we go now, will we make it in time?

rules.note: Only the complement cannot be doubled on its own: 看得懂不懂 and 看得不得懂 are wrong. The positive + negative question never takes 吗.

contrasts.wrong: 他说得太快，我不能听懂。

right.py: tā shuō de tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
right.en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand.

contrasts.why: Failing to reach a result is Verb + 不 + Result. 不能 is not put in front of verb + result to mean 'unable'.

contrasts.wrong: 人太多了，我们不能进去。

right.py: rén tài duō le wǒ men jìn bù qù
right.en: There are too many people; we can't get in.

contrasts.why: The crowd is a physical obstacle, so it is 进不去. 不能进去 says someone forbids it, which does not match the reason given.

contrasts.wrong: 这个手机太贵了，我不能买。

right.zh: 这个手机太贵了，我买不起。
right.py: zhè ge shǒu jī tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
right.en: This phone is too expensive; I can't afford it.

contrasts.why: 'Cannot afford' is the set form V不起. 不能买 means 'I must not buy it', which is not what 'too expensive' leads to.

right.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn bù dǒng

contrasts.why: 把 needs something actually done to the object; a potential complement only says whether it could be done. Front the object as a topic instead.

right.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā de huà
right.en: I can't understand what he says.

contrasts.why: Verb + 不 + result cannot be split by the object. The object follows the whole block or goes to the front.

contrasts.wrong: 昨天的电影我没看得懂。

right.py: zuó tiān de diàn yǐng wǒ méi kàn dǒng

contrasts.why: 没 cannot negate a potential form. Use 没 + verb + result for 'did not', or 看不懂 for 'cannot'.

right.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn de dǒng

contrasts.why: 得 here is the potential 得, not the degree 得, so nothing can be inserted before the result; 很 only fits the degree pattern (看得很快).

contrasts.wrong: 这个字太难了，我写得不好。

right.zh: 这个字太难了，我写不好。
right.py: zhè ge zì tài nán le wǒ xiě bù hǎo
right.en: This character is too hard; I can't write it well.

contrasts.why: 'Too hard' gives a reason for being unable, so the potential 写不好 is needed. 写得不好 only judges how something was or is written.

right.py: nǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
right.en: Can you hear it or not?

contrasts.why: The question repeats the whole form (听得见听不见) or just the verb (听不听得见); the complement alone cannot be doubled.

contrasts.wrong: 我想不起来了他的名字。

right.zh: 我想不起来他的名字了。
right.py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
right.en: I can't remember his name any more.

contrasts.why: The 了 that means 'now, any more' closes the sentence, so it comes after the object, not between the complement and the object.

cheat: 'Can't' because you would fail (too hard, far, many, heavy)? Verb + 不 + result, not 不能.
'Can't' because of a rule or someone says no? 不能 + verb.
得 or 不 sits right after the verb; nothing else (no 很, no object) goes inside.
No result word in mind? 不了 (liǎo): 去不了, 吃不了, 受不了.
Too expensive 买不起, none left 买不到, no room 吃不下, no time 来不及.
Can't do it well: 写不好. Does it badly: 写得不好.
Question: 看得懂吗 / 看得懂看不懂 / 看不看得懂. No 把, no 没 with these forms.

items.q: 你的声音太小，我___不见。
items.zh: 你的声音太小，我听不见。
items.py: nǐ de shēng yīn tài xiǎo wǒ tīng bù jiàn
items.en: Your voice is too quiet; I can't hear you.
items.why: Voices are heard, so the verb is 听 and 听不见 means cannot hear. 看不见 would mean cannot see, and 说不见 is not a word.

items.q: 昨天的作业我___做完。
items.zh: 昨天的作业我没做完。
items.py: zuó tiān de zuò yè wǒ méi zuò wán
items.en: I didn't finish yesterday's homework.
items.why: 昨天 reports one finished occasion that did not happen, so 没 + verb + result. 不 here would be a flat refusal, and the potential 做不完 puts 不 after the verb, not before it.

items.q: 这个词我在词典里找了半天，还是找___到。
items.zh: 这个词我在词典里找了半天，还是找不到。
items.py: zhè ge cí wǒ zài cí diǎn lǐ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shi zhǎo bù dào
items.en: I looked for this word in the dictionary for ages and still can't find it.
items.why: 还是 after a long search shows the failure continues, so 找不到 'cannot find'. 找得到 says the opposite, and 没 cannot go between 找 and 到.

items.q: 别担心，现在去图书馆还借___到那本书。
items.zh: 别担心，现在去图书馆还借得到那本书。
items.py: bié dān xīn xiàn zài qù tú shū guǎn hái jiè de dào nà běn shū
items.en: Don't worry, if you go to the library now you can still borrow that book.
items.why: 别担心 and 还 reassure that it is still possible, so the positive 得 goes between 借 and 到. 不 would say the opposite, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

items.q: 白板上的字太小，坐在后面的同学看___清楚。
items.zh: 白板上的字太小，坐在后面的同学看不清楚。
items.py: bái bǎn shàng de zì tài xiǎo zuò zài hòu miàn de tóng xué kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The writing on the whiteboard is too small; the students at the back can't see it clearly.
items.why: 太小 gives the reason for failure, so 不 goes between 看 and 清楚. 得 would claim they can see it, and 没 cannot sit inside the verb-result block.

items.q: 你说慢一点儿，我就听___懂。
items.zh: 你说慢一点儿，我就听得懂。
items.py: nǐ shuō màn yī diǎn r wǒ jiù tīng de dǒng
items.en: If you speak a bit more slowly, I'll be able to understand.
items.why: The condition 说慢一点儿 promises success, so the positive 得: 听得懂. 听不懂 would contradict the condition, and 了 cannot link a verb to its result.

items.q: 这份报告的数据太乱了，我整理了一个晚上也整理___好。
items.zh: 这份报告的数据太乱了，我整理了一个晚上也整理不好。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào de shù jù tài luàn le wǒ zhěng lǐ le yī ge wǎn shang yě zhěng lǐ bù hǎo
items.en: The data in this report is so messy that I couldn't get it sorted even after a whole evening.
items.why: 太乱了 and 也 (even after a whole evening) show repeated failure: 整理不好 'cannot manage to sort it out'. 得 would mean it can be done, and 没 is not placed between verb and result.

items.q: 门锁着，我们进___去。
items.zh: 门锁着，我们进不去。
items.py: mén suǒ zhe wǒ men jìn bù qù
items.en: The door is locked; we can't get in.
items.why: A locked door is a physical obstacle, so 不 goes between 进 and 去: 进不去. 进得去 says the opposite, and 没 cannot sit inside the block.

items.q: 你在山上，山太陡了，我爬不上___。
items.zh: 你在山上，山太陡了，我爬不上去。
items.py: nǐ zài shān shàng shān tài dǒu le wǒ pá bù shàng qù
items.en: You are up on the mountain, and it is too steep for me to climb up there.
items.why: You are up there, away from the speaker, so the direction word is 去. 来 would mean toward the speaker, and 回 would mean going back.

items.q: 新桌子到了门口，门太小，搬不___去。
items.zh: 新桌子到了门口，门太小，搬不进去。
items.py: xīn zhuō zi dào le mén kǒu mén tài xiǎo bān bù jìn qù
items.en: The new desk has reached the doorway, but the door is too small to carry it in.
items.why: The desk is outside and has to go into the room, so the direction is 进: 搬不进去. 出 would take it out of a room, and 回 would send it back.

items.q: 他的电话号码，我想___起来了。
items.zh: 他的电话号码，我想不起来了。
items.py: tā de diàn huà hào mǎ wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
items.en: I can't remember his phone number any more.
items.why: 想不起来 is the set form for failing to recall; 不 goes between 想 and 起来. 没 and 别 cannot go inside it, and the final 了 means 'now, any more'.

items.q: 我记得去年在会上见过这位客户，可是怎么也想___起来他叫什么。
items.zh: 我记得去年在会上见过这位客户，可是怎么也想不起来他叫什么。
items.py: wǒ jì de qù nián zài huì shàng jiàn guò zhè wèi kè hù kě shì zěn me yě xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā jiào shén me
items.en: I remember meeting this client at a meeting last year, but I just can't recall his name.
items.why: 怎么也 'no matter how' signals persistent failure, so 想不起来. 想得起来 would make the sentence illogical, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

items.q: 开了一上午会，腿都麻了，我一下子站___起来。
items.zh: 开了一上午会，腿都麻了，我一下子站不起来。
items.py: kāi le yī shàng wǔ huì tuǐ dōu má le wǒ yī xià zi zhàn bù qǐ lái
items.en: After a whole morning of meetings my legs are numb and I can't stand up right away.
items.why: Numb legs are the obstacle, so 站不起来. 站得起来 would deny the problem the first clause states, and 没 sits outside the block.

items.q: 这本词典太贵了，我买不___。
items.zh: 这本词典太贵了，我买不起。
items.py: zhè běn cí diǎn tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: This dictionary is too expensive; I can't afford it.
items.why: 太贵 means price is the obstacle, so 起 'afford': 买不起. 买不到 means none can be found for sale, and 买不完 means too much to finish buying.

items.q: 那本词典早就卖完了，现在书店里买不___。
items.zh: 那本词典早就卖完了，现在书店里买不到。
items.py: nà běn cí diǎn zǎo jiù mài wán le xiàn zài shū diàn lǐ mǎi bù dào
items.en: That dictionary sold out long ago; now you can't buy it in the bookstore.
items.why: 卖完了 means none is available, so 买不到 'cannot get hold of it'. 买不起 is about price, which the sentence never mentions, and 买不下 is not a form for this.

items.q: 我已经很饱了，一口也吃不___了。
items.zh: 我已经很饱了，一口也吃不下了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng hěn bǎo le yī kǒu yě chī bù xià le
items.en: I'm already full; I can't eat even one more bite.
items.why: Being full means there is no room left, which is 吃不下. 吃不完 is about too much food to finish, but 一口也 shows the problem is room, not quantity.

items.q: 这么多菜，我们三个人吃到明天也吃不___。
items.zh: 这么多菜，我们三个人吃到明天也吃不完。
items.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men sān ge rén chī dào míng tiān yě chī bù wán
items.en: There is so much food that the three of us couldn't finish it even by tomorrow.
items.why: The problem is the quantity, so 完 'finish': 吃不完. 吃不下 is about having no room in the stomach, which does not fit 吃到明天, and 起 is about money.

items.q: 现在去机场，已经来___及了。
items.zh: 现在去机场，已经来不及了。
items.py: xiàn zài qù jī chǎng yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
items.en: It is already too late to go to the airport now.
items.why: 已经 and 了 say time has run out: 来不及. 来得及 means there is still time, and 来没及 is not a form.

items.q: 离考试还有一个星期，现在开始复习还来___及。
items.zh: 离考试还有一个星期，现在开始复习还来得及。
items.py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu yī ge xīng qī xiàn zài kāi shǐ fù xí hái lái de jí
items.en: The exam is still a week away, so it is not too late to start revising now.
items.why: 还有一个星期 means time remains, so 来得及. 来不及 would say it is too late, and 来没及 is not a form.

items.q: 明天有考试，我现在紧张得怎么也睡___着。
items.zh: 明天有考试，我现在紧张得怎么也睡不着。
items.py: míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì wǒ xiàn zài jǐn zhāng de zěn me yě shuì bù zháo
items.en: I have an exam tomorrow and I'm so nervous I can't fall asleep no matter what.
items.why: 怎么也 shows repeated failure: 睡不着 'cannot fall asleep'. 睡得着 would be the opposite, and 睡没着 is not a form (it would be 没睡着).

items.q: 公司在市中心，那里的房租太高，刚毕业的学生都租___起。
items.zh: 公司在市中心，那里的房租太高，刚毕业的学生都租不起。
items.py: gōng sī zài shì zhōng xīn nà lǐ de fáng zū tài gāo gāng bì yè de xué sheng dōu zū bù qǐ
items.en: The company is in the city centre, where rents are so high that fresh graduates can't afford them.
items.why: 房租太高 is the price obstacle, so 租不起 'cannot afford to rent'. 租得起 contradicts it, and 了 does not link a verb and 起.

items.q: 对___起，我上课迟到了。
items.zh: 对不起，我上课迟到了。
items.py: duì bù qǐ wǒ shàng kè chí dào le
items.en: Sorry, I was late for class.
items.why: 对不起 is a fixed apology with 不 in the middle. 对得起 means 'to be worthy of, not let down', and 对没起 does not exist.

items.q: 明天我有事，去___了。
items.zh: 明天我有事，去不了。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ yǒu shì qù bù liǎo
items.en: I have something on tomorrow; I can't go.
items.why: With no result word, 不 + 了 (liǎo) says the action cannot happen: 去不了. 有事 is the obstacle, so 去得了 is wrong, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

items.q: 我发烧了，想去也___，你们去吧。
items.zh: 我发烧了，想去也去不了，你们去吧。
items.py: wǒ fā shāo le xiǎng qù yě qù bù liǎo nǐ men qù ba
items.en: I have a fever; even if I wanted to go I couldn't, so you go ahead.
items.why: 想去也 'even if I want to' sets up inability, so 去不了 (liǎo). 不去了 means 'decided not to go after all' and does not fit a wish that is blocked.

items.q: 天气太冷，我决定___，在家复习。
items.zh: 天气太冷，我决定不去了，在家复习。
items.py: tiān qì tài lěng wǒ jué dìng bù qù le zài jiā fù xí
items.en: It's too cold; I've decided not to go after all and will revise at home.
items.why: 决定 expresses a choice, so 不去了 'not going any more' (le). 去不了 expresses inability and cannot follow 决定.

items.q: 这么多文件，一个人一天处理___了。
items.zh: 这么多文件，一个人一天处理不了。
items.py: zhè me duō wén jiàn yī ge rén yī tiān chǔ lǐ bù liǎo
items.en: One person can't deal with this many documents in a day.
items.why: 这么多 gives the quantity obstacle, so 处理不了 (liǎo). 得 would claim it is easy, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

items.q: 办公室的空调坏了，太热了，我受___了。
items.zh: 办公室的空调坏了，太热了，我受不了。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de kōng tiáo huài le tài rè le wǒ shòu bù liǎo
items.en: The office air conditioning is broken; it is too hot and I can't stand it.
items.why: 受不了 (liǎo) is the set form for 'cannot bear it'. 没 and 别 cannot go inside it.

items.q: 这个问题太难了，我回答___了。
items.zh: 这个问题太难了，我回答不了。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí tài nán le wǒ huí dá bù liǎo
items.en: This question is too hard; I can't answer it.
items.why: 太难了 is the obstacle, so 回答不了 (liǎo). 回答得了 would say the opposite, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

items.q: 别担心，这点儿文件我一个人拿___了。
items.zh: 别担心，这点儿文件我一个人拿得了。
items.py: bié dān xīn zhè diǎn r wén jiàn wǒ yī ge rén ná de liǎo
items.en: Don't worry, I can carry this small pile of documents by myself.
items.why: 别担心 reassures, so the positive 拿得了 (liǎo). 拿不了 would worry rather than reassure, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

items.q: 李老师在课堂上说的那些话，我一辈子也忘___了。
items.zh: 李老师在课堂上说的那些话，我一辈子也忘不了。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī zài kè táng shàng shuō de nà xiē huà wǒ yī bèi zi yě wàng bù liǎo
items.en: I won't forget what Teacher Li said in class as long as I live.
items.why: 一辈子也 'not even in a lifetime' calls for 忘不了 (liǎo). 忘得了 would say you can forget, which reverses the meaning.

items.q: 里面在开会，你___。
items.zh: 里面在开会，你不能进去。
items.py: lǐ miàn zài kāi huì nǐ bù néng jìn qù
items.en: There is a meeting going on inside; you're not allowed in.
items.why: A meeting is a rule-based reason, so 'not allowed' is 不能进去. 进不去 is physical inability, as with a locked door or a packed room.

items.q: 门锁着，我怎么也___。
items.zh: 门锁着，我怎么也进不去。
items.py: mén suǒ zhe wǒ zěn me yě jìn bù qù
items.en: The door is locked and I can't get in no matter what I do.
items.why: 怎么也 shows trying and failing, which is inability: 进不去. 不能进去 is about permission and does not combine with 怎么也.

items.q: 这个箱子太重了，我用了很大力气也___。
items.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我用了很大力气也拿不动。
items.py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ yòng le hěn dà lì qi yě ná bù dòng
items.en: This suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it even with all my strength.
items.why: Weight and effort point to physical inability: 拿不动. 不能拿 would say 'must not take it' and does not fit the effort.

items.q: 这是公司的机密文件，你们___。
items.zh: 这是公司的机密文件，你们不能带走。
items.py: zhè shì gōng sī de jī mì wén jiàn nǐ men bù néng dài zǒu
items.en: These are confidential company files; you must not take them away.
items.why: 机密 means a rule forbids it, so 不能带走. 带不走 would say you are physically unable to take them away.

items.q: 图书馆规定这套珍藏本只能在馆内阅读，读者___。
items.zh: 图书馆规定这套珍藏本只能在馆内阅读，读者不能带出去。
items.py: tú shū guǎn guī dìng zhè tào zhēn cáng běn zhǐ néng zài guǎn nèi yuè dú dú zhě bù néng dài chū qù
items.en: The library rule is that this rare edition can only be read inside, so readers are not allowed to take it out.
items.why: 规定 and 只能 mark a rule, so 不能带出去. 带不出去 would mean readers are physically unable to carry it out.

items.q: 办公室在六楼，电梯坏了，这么大的柜子，我们三个人也___。
items.zh: 办公室在六楼，电梯坏了，这么大的柜子，我们三个人也抬不上去。
items.py: bàn gōng shì zài liù lóu diàn tī huài le zhè me dà de guì zi wǒ men sān ge rén yě tái bù shàng qù
items.en: The office is on the sixth floor and the lift is broken; the three of us can't carry such a big cabinet up.
items.why: Size and a broken lift are physical obstacles, so 抬不上去. 不能抬上去 would mean someone forbids carrying it up.

items.q: 昨天的作文我写___，老师给了我九十分。
items.zh: 昨天的作文我写得很好，老师给了我九十分。
items.py: zuó tiān de zuò wén wǒ xiě de hěn hǎo lǎo shī gěi le wǒ jiǔ shí fēn
items.en: I wrote yesterday's essay very well, and the teacher gave me ninety.
items.why: 九十分 shows the essay was done well, the degree pattern 写得很好. 写不好 'cannot write it well' and 写得不好 'writes it badly' both contradict the score.

items.q: 这个字太难了，我怎么写也写___。
items.zh: 这个字太难了，我怎么写也写不好。
items.py: zhè ge zì tài nán le wǒ zěn me xiě yě xiě bù hǎo
items.en: This character is too hard; however I write it, I can't get it right.
items.why: 太难了 and 怎么写也 describe repeated failure, so potential 写不好. 得很好 and 得挺好 would say the character is written well, which contradicts the sentence.

items.q: 他的汉语说___，常常帮同事翻译。
items.zh: 他的汉语说得很好，常常帮同事翻译。
items.py: tā de hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo cháng cháng bāng tóng shì fān yì
items.en: He speaks Chinese very well and often interprets for colleagues.
items.why: Interpreting for colleagues shows how well he speaks, the degree pattern 说得很好. 说不好 would mean he cannot say it well, and 说不了 is not a fit here.

items.q: 这些生词我___记不住。
items.zh: 这些生词我记不住。
items.py: zhè xiē shēng cí wǒ jì bù zhù
items.en: I can't remember these new words.
items.why: A potential complement only says whether something can be done, so 把 cannot be used; the object is simply fronted as a topic: 这些生词我记不住.

items.q: 这篇课文太长了，我___背不下来。
items.zh: 这篇课文太长了，我背不下来。
items.py: zhè piān kè wén tài cháng le wǒ bèi bù xià lái
items.en: This text is too long; I can't learn it by heart.
items.why: 背不下来 is a potential complement, which never takes 把. The sentence is complete without it, with the object as the topic at the front.

items.q: 这份中文报纸你看得懂看___懂？
items.zh: 这份中文报纸你看得懂看不懂？
items.py: zhè fèn zhōng wén bào zhǐ nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bù dǒng
items.en: Can you understand this Chinese newspaper or not?
items.why: The full positive + negative pair needs 不 to complete 看不懂. 没 cannot negate a potential form, and 吗 never goes inside the pair.

items.q: 你看___看得懂这份英文合同？
items.zh: 你看不看得懂这份英文合同？
items.py: nǐ kàn bù kàn de dǒng zhè fèn yīng wén hé tong
items.en: Can you understand this English contract?
items.why: The short form V不V得R repeats only the verb with 不: 看不看得懂. 没 cannot negate a potential form, and 吗 does not go inside the question.

items.zh: 你们听得见听不见？
items.py: nǐ men tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
items.en: Can you hear it or not?
items.why: Ask with the full positive + negative pair, 听得见听不见. 听得见不见 cuts the negative half down to the complement alone, which is not a form.

items.zh: 我听不懂他的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā de huà
items.en: I can't understand what he says.
items.why: 听不懂 is one unit; the object follows it, or goes in front as a topic. The object cannot be put between 听 and 懂.

items.zh: 我想不起来他的电话号码了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de diàn huà hào mǎ le
items.en: I can't remember his phone number any more.
items.why: The object follows the whole 想不起来 block or is fronted as a topic, and the sentence-final 了 comes after the object.

items.zh: 现在去已经来不及了。
items.py: xiàn zài qù yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
items.en: It is already too late to go there now.
items.why: 已经 comes before 来不及, and 了 closes the sentence. 来不及 is a fixed unit and 现在去 stays in front of it.

items.zh: 今天我来不了。
items.py: jīn tiān wǒ lái bù liǎo
items.en: I can't come today.
items.why: 来不了 (liǎo) is the unit; the time word may stand before or after the subject but both stay in front of the verb.

items.zh: 你不能带走这些资料。
items.py: nǐ bù néng dài zǒu zhè xiē zī liào
items.en: You must not take these documents away.
items.why: Not allowed is 不能 + verb, and the object either follows the verb or is fronted as a topic. 不能 comes before 带走.

items.zh: 这个字太难了，我写不好。
items.py: zhè ge zì tài nán le wǒ xiě bù hǎo
items.en: This character is too hard; I can't write it well.
items.why: The reason clause comes first and the potential 写不好 follows. Nothing is inserted between 写 and 好.

items.zh: 你听不听得见老师的声音？
items.py: nǐ tīng bù tīng de jiàn lǎo shī de shēng yīn
items.en: Can you hear the teacher's voice?
items.why: V不V得R: the verb is repeated with 不, then the full 听得见. The object comes after the whole question block or in front as a topic.

items.zh: 你看得见黑板上的字吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn de jiàn hēi bǎn shàng de zì ma
items.en: Can you see the writing on the blackboard?
items.why: Question with 吗: the potential form stays whole and 吗 closes the sentence. 吗 cannot be put before 看得见.

items.zh: 离开会还有二十分钟，现在去来得及吗？
items.py: lí kāi huì hái yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng xiàn zài qù lái de jí ma
items.en: The meeting starts in twenty minutes; will we make it if we go now?
items.why: The time limit comes first, then the action, then 来得及 and 吗. 来得及 follows the action it is about.

items.zh: 门太小了，桌子搬不进去。
items.py: mén tài xiǎo le zhuō zi bān bù jìn qù
items.en: The door is too small; the table can't be carried in.
items.why: 搬不进去 is the unit, with 不 between 搬 and 进去. The reason can come first or last, but 不 never goes before 搬.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
items.task: Say you can't understand it.
items.zh: 我听不懂老师的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng lǎo shī de huà
items.en: I can't understand what the teacher says.
items.why: Put 不 between verb and result: 听不懂. The 了 of the completed action goes, and the object follows the block or comes first as a topic.

items.src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le nà fèn wén jiàn
items.task: Say you can't find it.
items.zh: 我找不到那份文件。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào nà fèn wén jiàn
items.en: I can't find that document.
items.why: Inability is 找不到, with 不 inside the verb-result block. 不找到 and 没找得到 are both wrong.

items.src_py: xiǎo wáng zuò wán le zhè ge biǎo gé
items.task: Say he can't finish it.
items.zh: 小王做不完这个表格。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuò bù wán zhè ge biǎo gé
items.en: Xiao Wang can't finish this form.
items.why: 做完 becomes 做不完 by putting 不 in the middle; the completion 了 is dropped because the potential form does not take it.

items.src_py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.task: Say you did not understand it (one occasion), using 没.
items.zh: 昨天的课我没听懂。
items.py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: I didn't understand yesterday's class.
items.why: For one finished occasion, 没 goes before verb + result: 没听懂. The potential 听不懂 describes ability instead.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn de dǒng zhè fèn bào gào
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 我看不懂这份报告。
items.py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè fèn bào gào
items.en: I can't understand this report.
items.why: Negate a potential form by changing 得 to 不, not by adding 不 or 没 in front: 看不懂.

items.src_py: rén hěn shǎo wǒ men jìn de qù
items.task: The place is packed: say we can't get in.
items.zh: 人太多了，我们进不去。
items.py: rén tài duō le wǒ men jìn bù qù
items.en: There are too many people; we can't get in.
items.why: A crowd is a physical obstacle, so 不 replaces 得: 进不去. 不能进去 would mean it is not allowed.

items.src_py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
items.task: Say you can't recall it.
items.zh: 我想不起来他的名字了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
items.en: I can't remember his name any more.
items.why: 想起来 becomes 想不起来 with 不 inserted before the direction word; the final 了 stays after the object.

items.src_py: wǒ pá de shàng nà zuò shān
items.task: Say it is too high and you can't climb it.
items.zh: 山太高了，我爬不上去。
items.py: shān tài gāo le wǒ pá bù shàng qù
items.en: The mountain is too high; I can't climb up it.
items.why: Inability is 爬不上去, with 不 inside the verb-direction block and 去 for a place away from the speaker.

items.src_py: wǒ jīn wǎn huí de lái
items.task: Say you can't get back tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚回不来。
items.py: wǒ jīn wǎn huí bù lái
items.en: I can't get back tonight.
items.why: Change 得 to 不: 回不来. The direction word 来 stays because the speaker is the place being returned to.

items.src_py: xué fèi bù gāo wǒ jiāo de qǐ
items.task: Say the fees are too high to afford.
items.zh: 学费太高了，我交不起。
items.py: xué fèi tài gāo le wǒ jiāo bù qǐ
items.en: The fees are too high; I can't afford them.
items.why: Cannot afford is V不起, so 交得起 turns into 交不起. 不能交 would mean it is forbidden.

items.src_py: wǒ hěn è hái chī de xià
items.task: Say you are full and can't eat any more.
items.zh: 我吃饱了，再也吃不下了。
items.py: wǒ chī bǎo le zài yě chī bù xià le
items.en: I'm full; I can't eat any more.
items.why: No room left is 吃不下. 再也 goes in front of it, and 了 at the end marks the new state.

items.src_py: wǒ lái de jí jiāo zuò yè
items.task: Say it is too late to hand in the homework.
items.zh: 我来不及交作业了。
items.py: wǒ lái bù jí jiāo zuò yè le
items.en: I don't have time to hand in the homework now.
items.why: 来得及 becomes 来不及, and the verb phrase follows it directly. 了 marks that time has run out.

items.src: 这个房间很大，住得下十个人。
items.src_py: zhè ge fáng jiān hěn dà zhù de xià shí ge rén
items.task: Say it is too small for ten people.
items.zh: 这个房间太小了，住不下十个人。
items.py: zhè ge fáng jiān tài xiǎo le zhù bù xià shí ge rén
items.en: This room is too small; it can't fit ten people.
items.why: No room for them is V不下: 住不下. The number-phrase object follows the block or is fronted before it.

items.src_py: wǒ míng tiān kě yǐ qù
items.task: Say you can't go tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天去不了。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān qù bù liǎo
items.en: I can't go tomorrow.
items.why: With no result word, use 不了 (liǎo) after the verb: 去不了. 可以 is dropped because permission is no longer the point.

items.src: 这点儿工作，一个人做得了。
items.src_py: zhè diǎn r gōng zuò yī ge rén zuò de liǎo
items.task: Say one person can't manage all this work.
items.zh: 这么多工作，一个人做不了。
items.py: zhè me duō gōng zuò yī ge rén zuò bù liǎo
items.en: One person can't do this much work.
items.why: Too much to finish is V不了 (liǎo). 得 becomes 不, and 这么多 gives the reason.

items.src_py: wǒ yào qù cān jiā péi xùn
items.task: Say you have changed your mind and are not going after all.
items.zh: 我不去参加培训了。
items.py: wǒ bù qù cān jiā péi xùn le
items.en: I'm not going to the training after all.
items.why: A changed decision is 不 + verb + 了 (le). It is not 去不了, which would mean unable to go.

items.src: 这么多项目，我一个人完成得了。
items.src_py: zhè me duō xiàng mù wǒ yī ge rén wán chéng de liǎo
items.task: Say you can't manage them alone.
items.zh: 这么多项目，我一个人完成不了。
items.py: zhè me duō xiàng mù wǒ yī ge rén wán chéng bù liǎo
items.en: I can't complete this many projects by myself.
items.why: Too many to finish is V不了 (liǎo). The positive 得了 becomes 不了, and no 把 or extra 不 is added.

items.src_py: nǐ kě yǐ jìn qù
items.task: Say you are not allowed to go in.
items.zh: 你不能进去。
items.py: nǐ bù néng jìn qù
items.en: You're not allowed in.
items.why: Not allowed is 不能 + verb, so 可以 becomes 不能. 进不去 would say you are physically unable.

items.src_py: zhè ge xiāng zi wǒ ná de dòng
items.task: Say it is too heavy for you to lift.
items.zh: 箱子太重了，我拿不动。
items.py: xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ ná bù dòng
items.en: The suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it.
items.why: Weight is a physical obstacle, so 拿不动 rather than 不能拿.

items.src_py: wǒ xiě zhè ge zì xiě de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say you are unable to write this character well.
items.zh: 这个字我写不好。
items.py: zhè ge zì wǒ xiě bù hǎo
items.en: I can't write this character well.
items.why: Unable to do it well is potential 写不好, with no 很. 写得不好 would only say it is written poorly.

items.src_py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu
items.task: Say she did not speak clearly.
items.zh: 她说得不清楚。
items.py: tā shuō de bù qīng chu
items.en: She didn't speak clearly.
items.why: This judges how she spoke, so it is the degree pattern 说得不清楚. The potential 说不清楚 would say she cannot explain it.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè fèn hé tong
items.task: Say it with the contract as the topic.
items.zh: 这份合同我看不懂。
items.py: zhè fèn hé tong wǒ kàn bù dǒng
items.en: I can't understand this contract.
items.why: The topic can be fronted, but never with 把, and never between 看 and 不懂.

items.src: 我把那个问题讲清楚了。
items.src_py: wǒ bǎ nà ge wèn tí jiǎng qīng chu le
items.task: Say you can't explain it clearly. Do not use 把.
items.zh: 那个问题我讲不清楚。
items.py: nà ge wèn tí wǒ jiǎng bù qīng chu
items.en: I can't explain that question clearly.
items.why: Potential complements do not take 把, so the object moves in front as a topic or follows 讲不清楚.

items.src_py: nǐ tīng de jiàn
items.task: Turn it into a positive-negative question.
items.zh: 你听得见听不见？
items.py: nǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
items.en: Can you hear it or not?
items.why: The full positive and negative forms sit side by side. 吗 is not added, and the complement alone is not doubled.

items.s: 老师的话我没听得懂。
items.s_py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ méi tīng de dǒng
items.zh: 老师的话我没听懂。
items.py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
items.why: 没 negates a result complement (没听懂), but it can never be put in front of a 得 form such as 听得懂.

items.s: 昨天我找了半天，也没找到那本书。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào nà běn shū
items.zh: 昨天我找了半天，也没找到那本书。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào nà běn shū
items.en: I searched for ages yesterday and still did not find the book.
items.why: This is correct: for one past occasion 没找到 is the natural choice, while 找不到 would describe being unable to find it.

items.s: 我想起不来那位老师的名字了。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ bù lái nà wèi lǎo shī de míng zi le
items.zh: 我想不起来那位老师的名字了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái nà wèi lǎo shī de míng zi le
items.en: I can't remember that teacher's name any more.
items.why: 不 must sit directly after 想, before 起来 as a whole. Splitting 起 and 来 with 不 is wrong.

items.s: 这个房间的门很大，沙发搬得进去。
items.s_py: zhè ge fáng jiān de mén hěn dà shā fā bān de jìn qù
items.zh: 这个房间的门很大，沙发搬得进去。
items.py: zhè ge fáng jiān de mén hěn dà shā fā bān de jìn qù
items.en: The door of this room is big; the sofa can be carried in.
items.why: Correct: positive 得 states it can be done, and the topic 沙发 stands at the front.

items.s: 对得起，我来晚了。
items.s_py: duì de qǐ wǒ lái wǎn le
items.zh: 对不起，我来晚了。
items.py: duì bù qǐ wǒ lái wǎn le
items.en: Sorry I'm late.
items.why: The apology is the fixed 对不起. 对得起 means 'to be worthy of' and cannot be used to say sorry.

items.s: 这个会议室坐得下二十个人。
items.s_py: zhè ge huì yì shì zuò de xià èr shí ge rén
items.zh: 这个会议室坐得下二十个人。
items.py: zhè ge huì yì shì zuò de xià èr shí ge rén
items.en: This meeting room can seat twenty people.
items.why: Correct: V得下 means there is room for them, and the number-phrase object follows the block.

items.s: 这么多菜，我一个人吃不了完。
items.s_py: zhè me duō cài wǒ yī ge rén chī bù liǎo wán
items.zh: 这么多菜，我一个人吃不完。
items.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ yī ge rén chī bù wán
items.en: There is so much food that I can't finish it alone.
items.why: Only one complement fits in the block: 吃不完 or 吃不了. Stacking 不了 and 完 is not possible.

items.s: 我去不了了，你们去吧。
items.s_py: wǒ qù bù liǎo le nǐ men qù ba
items.zh: 我去不了了，你们去吧。
items.py: wǒ qù bù liǎo le nǐ men qù ba
items.en: I can't go now, so you go ahead.
items.why: Correct: 去不了 (liǎo) followed by the 'now' 了 (le) is a regular combination.

items.s: 这个箱子太重了，我不能拿动。
items.s_py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ bù néng ná dòng
items.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我拿不动。
items.py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ ná bù dòng
items.en: This suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it.
items.why: Being unable to lift it is 拿不动. 不能 does not go in front of a verb + result to mean inability.

items.s: 这些资料是内部的，你不能带出办公室。
items.s_py: zhè xiē zī liào shì nèi bù de nǐ bù néng dài chū bàn gōng shì
items.zh: 这些资料是内部的，你不能带出办公室。
items.py: zhè xiē zī liào shì nèi bù de nǐ bù néng dài chū bàn gōng shì
items.en: These documents are internal; you must not take them out of the office.
items.why: Correct: a rule is expressed with 不能 + verb phrase, and 带出办公室 has no potential complement in it.

items.s: 我的字写不得好。
items.s_py: wǒ de zì xiě bù dé hǎo
items.zh: 我的字写得不好。
items.py: wǒ de zì xiě de bù hǎo
items.en: My handwriting isn't good.
items.why: To say how well something is written use 得 first and then 不好: 写得不好. 写不得好 is not a possible order.

items.s: 他说得很快，我听不懂。
items.s_py: tā shuō de hěn kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.zh: 他说得很快，我听不懂。
items.py: tā shuō de hěn kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He speaks very fast; I can't understand.
items.why: Correct: the first clause is the degree pattern with 很, and the second is a potential form without 很.

items.s: 我把这篇课文背不下来。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè piān kè wén bèi bù xià lái
items.zh: 这篇课文我背不下来。
items.py: zhè piān kè wén wǒ bèi bù xià lái
items.en: I can't recite this text from memory.
items.why: 把 is never used with a potential complement. Front the object as a topic instead.

items.s: 我看电脑上的字不清楚。
items.s_py: wǒ kàn diàn nǎo shàng de zì bù qīng chu
items.zh: 我看不清楚电脑上的字。
items.py: wǒ kàn bù qīng chu diàn nǎo shàng de zì
items.en: I can't see the words on the computer clearly.
items.why: The object cannot be put between 看 and 不清楚. It follows the whole block or goes to the front.

items.s: 这本书你看得不得懂？
items.s_py: zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de bù de dǒng
items.zh: 这本书你看得懂看不懂？
items.py: zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bù dǒng
items.en: Can you understand this book or not?
items.why: The pair must repeat the whole form (看得懂看不懂) or the verb (看不看得懂). 看得不得懂 puts 得 and 不 side by side, which is not a form.

items.s: 你听不听得见我说话？
items.s_py: nǐ tīng bù tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà
items.zh: 你听不听得见我说话？
items.py: nǐ tīng bù tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà
items.en: Can you hear me speaking?
items.why: Correct: V不V得R is the colloquial question form for potential complements and takes no 吗.

items.q: 弟弟跑___很快，同学们都比不上他。
items.zh: 弟弟跑得很快，同学们都比不上他。
items.py: dì di pǎo de hěn kuài tóng xué men dōu bǐ bù shàng tā
items.en: My brother runs very fast; none of his classmates can match him.
items.why: 很 describes how he runs, so the degree complement 得 links verb and adjective. 不 would form a potential 跑不快, which cannot take 很.

items.q: 这么多水果，我们一家三口一个星期也吃___了。
items.zh: 这么多水果，我们一家三口一个星期也吃不了。
items.py: zhè me duō shuǐ guǒ wǒ men yī jiā sān kǒu yī ge xīng qī yě chī bù liǎo
items.en: With this much fruit, the three of us can't finish it even in a week.
items.why: Too much to get through, with no result word: 吃不了 (liǎo). 也 ('even in a week') signals failure, so 吃得了 is out.

items.s: 门这么小，大沙发怎么搬得进去？
items.s_py: mén zhè me xiǎo dà shā fā zěn me bān de jìn qù
items.zh: 门这么小，大沙发怎么搬得进去？
items.py: mén zhè me xiǎo dà shā fā zěn me bān de jìn qù
items.en: The door is so small; how can the big sofa possibly get in?
items.why: A positive potential 搬得进去 is natural in a rhetorical 怎么 question meaning 'how could it be carried in'.

items.s: 这些菜你们吃得完不完？
items.s_py: zhè xiē cài nǐ men chī de wán bù wán
items.zh: 这些菜你们吃得完吃不完？
items.py: zhè xiē cài nǐ men chī de wán chī bù wán
items.en: Can you finish all these dishes or not?
items.why: The pair repeats the whole form (吃得完吃不完). Doubling only the complement, 吃得完不完, is not allowed.

items.src_py: zhè jiàn yī fu nǐ mǎi de qǐ
items.task: Ask 'can you afford it or not?' with both forms side by side.
items.zh: 这件衣服你买得起买不起？
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu nǐ mǎi de qǐ mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: Can you afford this piece of clothing or not?
items.why: The full pair 买得起买不起 is the alternative question and takes no 吗. Doubling only the complement (买得起不起) is not allowed.

items.q: 我们家的客厅很小，要是亲戚都来，肯定坐不___。
items.zh: 我们家的客厅很小，要是亲戚都来，肯定坐不下。
items.py: wǒ men jiā de kè tīng hěn xiǎo yào shi qīn qi dōu lái kěn dìng zuò bù xià
items.en: Our living room is small; if all the relatives come, there definitely won't be room for everyone to sit.
items.why: Room for people is expressed by 下: 坐不下 'no space to seat them'. 坐不起 and 坐不动 are about money and strength, not space.

items.s: 弟弟发烧了，这次旅行他去不了了。
items.s_py: dì di fā shāo le zhè cì lǚ xíng tā qù bù liǎo le
items.zh: 弟弟发烧了，这次旅行他去不了了。
items.py: dì di fā shāo le zhè cì lǚ xíng tā qù bù liǎo le
items.en: My brother has a fever; he can't go on this trip any more.
items.why: 去不了 (liǎo) is 'cannot go', and the final 了 marks the changed situation. Two different 了 can stand together here.

items.s: 弟弟看这封信不懂。
items.s_py: dì di kàn zhè fēng xìn bù dǒng
items.zh: 弟弟看不懂这封信。
items.py: dì di kàn bù dǒng zhè fēng xìn
items.en: My brother can't understand this letter.
items.why: The object cannot split the verb from its potential block. It comes after 看不懂 or is fronted (这封信弟弟看不懂).

items.q: 这家手机店很大，你一定找___到。
items.zh: 这家手机店很大，你一定找得到。
items.py: zhè jiā shǒu jī diàn hěn dà nǐ yī dìng zhǎo de dào
items.en: This phone shop is big; you're sure to find it.
items.why: 一定 expresses certainty that the result will be reached, so the positive 得 fits: 找得到. 不 would say you are sure to fail, against the cue.

items.q: 明天我要照顾妹妹，我去___你家。
items.zh: 明天我要照顾妹妹，我去不了你家。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ yào zhào gù mèi mei wǒ qù bù liǎo nǐ jiā
items.en: I have to look after my sister tomorrow, so I can't go to your place.
items.why: No result word is wanted: the action itself cannot happen, so 不了 (liǎo) follows 去. 去不到 / 去不起 / 去不动 give meanings (reach, afford, too weak) the reason does not support.

items.q: 妈妈说话太小声，我听___见。
items.zh: 妈妈说话太小声，我听不见。
items.py: mā ma shuō huà tài xiǎo shēng wǒ tīng bù jiàn
items.en: Mom speaks too quietly; I can't hear her.
items.why: 太小声 is the reason the result cannot be reached, so 不 goes between 听 and 见 (听不见). 听得见 would say the opposite, and 没 cannot sit inside a verb-result block.

items.src: 现在的房子，年轻人买得起。
items.src_py: xiàn zài de fáng zi nián qīng rén mǎi de qǐ
items.task: Say young people cannot afford them.
items.zh: 现在的房子，年轻人买不起。
items.py: xiàn zài de fáng zi nián qīng rén mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: Young people can't afford houses these days.
items.why: 起 means 'afford'; flipping 得 to 不 turns 'can afford' into 'cannot afford'. The object may be fronted as a topic or follow the block.

items.src_py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ shuō de qīng chu
items.task: Say you cannot explain this matter clearly.
items.zh: 这件事我说不清楚。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ shuō bù qīng chu
items.en: I can't explain this matter clearly.
items.why: Inability to explain is potential 不 right after 说, with nothing before 清楚. 说得不清楚 would only criticise how it was said.

items.q: 家里没有空调，夏天热得我受___了。
items.zh: 家里没有空调，夏天热得我受不了。
items.py: jiā lǐ méi yǒu kōng tiáo xià tiān rè de wǒ shòu bù liǎo
items.en: There's no air conditioning at home; in summer it's so hot I can't stand it.
items.why: 受不了 (liǎo) is the set phrase for 'cannot stand'. The heat without air conditioning is the reason, so 不. 受得了 would mean you can bear it.

items.zh: 哥哥今天回不来了。
items.py: gē ge jīn tiān huí bù lái le
items.en: My older brother can't come back today.
items.why: 不 goes between 回 and the direction 来, and the 了 of the new situation closes the sentence. 不回来 would be a different, refusing meaning.

items.q: 我感冒得很厉害，明天爸爸的生日聚会我恐怕来___了。
items.zh: 我感冒得很厉害，明天爸爸的生日聚会我恐怕来不了。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào de hěn lì hai míng tiān bà ba de shēng rì jù huì wǒ kǒng pà lái bù liǎo
items.en: I have a terrible cold; I'm afraid I can't make it to Dad's birthday party tomorrow.
items.why: A bad cold stops you coming: 来不了 (liǎo). 恐怕 'I'm afraid' goes with a negative outcome, so 来得了 does not fit.

items.q: 我在房间里说话，你在客厅里听得见___？
items.zh: 我在房间里说话，你在客厅里听得见听不见？
items.py: wǒ zài fáng jiān lǐ shuō huà nǐ zài kè tīng lǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
items.en: I'm talking in my room; can you hear me in the living room or not?
items.why: The alternative question pairs the full forms: 听得见听不见. Doubling only the complement or adding 吗 and 不 together is not allowed.

items.src: 我想不起来那家商店的名字。
items.src_py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái nà jiā shāng diàn de míng zi
items.task: Add 'any more' with 了.
items.zh: 我想不起来那家商店的名字了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái nà jiā shāng diàn de míng zi le
items.en: I can't remember the name of that shop any more.
items.why: Sentence-final 了 closes the sentence after the object; it cannot sit between 起来 and the object.

items.src: 弟弟听得懂电视里的话。
items.src_py: dì di tīng de dǒng diàn shì lǐ de huà
items.task: Ask it the colloquial way: repeat only the verb with 不 (V不V得R).
items.zh: 弟弟听不听得懂电视里的话？
items.py: dì di tīng bù tīng de dǒng diàn shì lǐ de huà
items.en: Can my brother understand what they say on TV?
items.why: V不V得R: the first verb takes 不 and the second carries 得 + result. 吗 is not added to this question.

items.zh: 你看不看得懂这张说明书？
items.py: nǐ kàn bù kàn de dǒng zhè zhāng shuō míng shū
items.en: Can you understand this instruction sheet?
items.why: V不V得R: 看不 comes first and the complete 看得懂 follows. The object goes after the whole question block or in front of it.

items.q: 妈妈要做的菜太多了，一个下午做___完。
items.zh: 妈妈要做的菜太多了，一个下午做不完。
items.py: mā ma yào zuò de cài tài duō le yī ge xià wǔ zuò bù wán
items.en: Mom has too many dishes to cook; she can't finish them in one afternoon.
items.why: 太多了 is the reason she will fail to finish, so 不 goes between 做 and 完. 得 would claim she can manage it, against the cue.

items.zh: 妹妹的字写得很好。
items.py: mèi mei de zì xiě de hěn hǎo
items.en: My sister's handwriting is very good.
items.why: Here 得 is the degree complement, and 很 sits between 得 and the adjective. A potential 写不好 would take no 很.

items.q: 我找___我的钱包。
items.zh: 我找不到我的钱包。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de qián bāo
items.en: I can't find my wallet.
items.why: 不 goes between 找 and 到, and the object comes after the whole block. 找得不到 and 找不得到 put the pieces in orders that do not exist.

items.q: 这个手机只要两百块，很便宜，我买___起。
items.zh: 这个手机只要两百块，很便宜，我买得起。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài hěn pián yi wǒ mǎi de qǐ
items.en: This phone is only two hundred yuan, very cheap; I can afford it.
items.why: Cheap means the price is within reach, so the positive 得: 买得起. 买不起 would contradict 只要两百块.

items.zh: 爸爸明天来不了。
items.py: bà ba míng tiān lái bù liǎo
items.en: Dad can't come tomorrow.
items.why: 不了 (liǎo) after 来 says the action itself cannot happen. Subject and time word come first and 来不了 closes the sentence.

items.q: 这个沙发太重了，我们两个人也抬___上去。
items.zh: 这个沙发太重了，我们两个人也抬不上去。
items.py: zhè ge shā fā tài zhòng le wǒ men liǎng ge rén yě tái bù shàng qù
items.en: This sofa is so heavy that even the two of us can't carry it up.
items.why: 太重了 and 也 ('even two people') point to failure, so 不 between 抬 and 上去. 抬得上去 would mean they can; 抬能上去 is not a form.

items.q: 这件事太复杂了，我说___清楚。
items.zh: 这件事太复杂了，我说不清楚。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì tài fù zá le wǒ shuō bù qīng chu
items.en: This matter is too complicated; I can't explain it clearly.
items.why: 太复杂了 explains why you are unable, so potential 不 goes directly between 说 and 清楚; 很 never enters a potential form. 说得很清楚 would mean 'explains very clearly'.

items.q: 离火车开还有两个多小时，我们先回家拿行李，一定来___及。
items.zh: 离火车开还有两个多小时，我们先回家拿行李，一定来得及。
items.py: lí huǒ chē kāi hái yǒu liǎng ge duō xiǎo shí wǒ men xiān huí jiā ná xíng li yī dìng lái de jí
items.en: The train leaves in a little over two hours; we can go home for the luggage first and will surely make it in time.
items.why: Two hours is plenty of time, and 一定 states certainty, so the positive 来得及. 来不及 would contradict both.

items.s: 我找了半天，还是没找到我的钱包。
items.s_py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shi méi zhǎo dào wǒ de qián bāo
items.zh: 我找了半天，还是没找到我的钱包。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shi méi zhǎo dào wǒ de qián bāo
items.en: I searched for ages and still haven't found my wallet.
items.why: 没 + verb + result reports that on this occasion the result was not reached. This is correct and not a potential form.

items.src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le yào shi
items.task: Say you cannot find the key (potential form).
items.zh: 我找不到钥匙。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào yào shi
items.en: I can't find the key.
items.why: Verb + 不 + result: 不 moves inside the block and 了 is dropped. The object follows the block or is fronted.

items.src: 爸爸的书房，我们进得去。
items.src_py: bà ba de shū fáng wǒ men jìn de qù
items.task: Change it: Dad's rule is that we must not go in.
items.zh: 爸爸的书房，我们不能进去。
items.py: bà ba de shū fáng wǒ men bù néng jìn qù
items.en: We aren't allowed into Dad's study.
items.why: A rule or ban is 不能 + verb, with 进去 whole after it. 进不去 would mean a physical obstacle such as a locked door.

items.q: 这么多作业，你今天做得完做___完？
items.zh: 这么多作业，你今天做得完做不完？
items.py: zhè me duō zuò yè nǐ jīn tiān zuò de wán zuò bù wán
items.en: With this much homework, can you finish it today or not?
items.why: The full pair repeats the whole potential: 做得完做不完. The negative half is 不 between verb and result; 没 and 不得 do not make a potential.

items.src_py: zhè zuò shān yé ye pá de shàng qù
items.task: Say Grandpa cannot climb up it.
items.zh: 这座山爷爷爬不上去。
items.py: zhè zuò shān yé ye pá bù shàng qù
items.en: Grandpa can't climb up this mountain.
items.why: 得 becomes 不 in the same slot. The two-part direction 上去 stays whole, so the object 这座山 is fronted as a topic.

items.s: 弟弟唱歌唱不很好，大家都爱听。
items.s_py: dì di chàng gē chàng bù hěn hǎo dà jiā dōu ài tīng
items.zh: 弟弟唱歌唱得很好，大家都爱听。
items.py: dì di chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo dà jiā dōu ài tīng
items.en: My brother sings very well and everyone likes to listen.
items.why: To say how well he sings, use the degree complement 唱得很好. A potential 不 never takes 很, so 唱不很好 is not a form.

items.s: 冰箱太小了，放不下这么多水果。
items.s_py: bīng xiāng tài xiǎo le fàng bù xià zhè me duō shuǐ guǒ
items.zh: 冰箱太小了，放不下这么多水果。
items.py: bīng xiāng tài xiǎo le fàng bù xià zhè me duō shuǐ guǒ
items.en: The fridge is too small to hold this much fruit.
items.why: 下 means enough room, so 放不下 + object after the block is correct. 不能放 would be a ban.

items.src_py: míng tiān wǒ qù nǐ jiā
items.task: Say you cannot go to their house tomorrow (use 不了).
items.zh: 明天我去不了你家。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ qù bù liǎo nǐ jiā
items.en: I can't go to your place tomorrow.
items.why: No result word fits, so 不了 (liǎo) follows the verb: the action itself cannot happen. 不去了 would mean having decided not to go.

items.s: 门上贴着通知，没有老师同意，学生不能进去。
items.s_py: mén shàng tiē zhe tōng zhī méi yǒu lǎo shī tóng yì xué sheng bù néng jìn qù
items.zh: 门上贴着通知，没有老师同意，学生不能进去。
items.py: mén shàng tiē zhe tōng zhī méi yǒu lǎo shī tóng yì xué sheng bù néng jìn qù
items.en: A notice on the door says students can't go in without the teacher's consent.
items.why: A notice is a rule, so 不能 + 进去 is right. 进不去 would only say they are physically unable to get in.

items.src_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ shuì zháo le
items.task: Say you could not fall asleep last night (potential, no 了).
items.zh: 昨天晚上我睡不着。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ shuì bù zháo
items.en: I couldn't fall asleep last night.
items.why: 睡不着 is the set potential for failing to fall asleep and takes no 了 even for a past night.

items.q: 医生说爸爸刚做完手术，现在还___下床。
items.zh: 医生说爸爸刚做完手术，现在还不能下床。
items.py: yī shēng shuō bà ba gāng zuò wán shǒu shù xiàn zài hái bù néng xià chuáng
items.en: The doctor says Dad has just had an operation and must not get out of bed yet.
items.why: A doctor's instruction means not allowed: 不能 + verb. 不会, 不了 and 不到 cannot stand in front of 下床 with this meaning.

items.q: 我肚子已经很饱了，再好吃的蛋糕也吃不___了。
items.zh: 我肚子已经很饱了，再好吃的蛋糕也吃不下了。
items.py: wǒ dù zi yǐ jīng hěn bǎo le zài hǎo chī de dàn gāo yě chī bù xià le
items.en: I'm already full; I can't eat any more, even the tastiest cake.
items.why: A full stomach means no room, which is 下: 吃不下. 吃不完 is about too much food to finish, not about being full.

items.s: 这么贵的手机，我不买起。
items.s_py: zhè me guì de shǒu jī wǒ bù mǎi qǐ
items.zh: 这么贵的手机，我买不起。
items.py: zhè me guì de shǒu jī wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: I can't afford such an expensive phone.
items.why: 'Cannot afford' is 买不起 with 不 inside the block. 不买起 puts 不 before the verb, which is not a form.

items.q: 外面太吵了，我怎么也睡___好。
items.zh: 外面太吵了，我怎么也睡不好。
items.py: wài miàn tài chǎo le wǒ zěn me yě shuì bù hǎo
items.en: It's too noisy outside; I can't sleep well no matter what.
items.why: 太吵了 and 怎么也 mean 'unable', so the potential 睡不好. 睡得好 and 睡得很好 describe how well you sleep and do not fit 'can't no matter what'.

items.src: 这张沙发我们搬得进去。
items.src_py: zhè zhāng shā fā wǒ men bān de jìn qù
items.task: Say we cannot carry it in.
items.zh: 这张沙发我们搬不进去。
items.py: zhè zhāng shā fā wǒ men bān bù jìn qù
items.en: We can't get this sofa in.
items.why: 不 replaces 得 right after the verb, before the direction word. 进去 stays whole, so the object is fronted.

items.q: 妈妈说了，晚上十点以后你们___玩，必须在家睡觉。
items.zh: 妈妈说了，晚上十点以后你们不能出去玩，必须在家睡觉。
items.py: mā ma shuō le wǎn shang shí diǎn yǐ hòu nǐ men bù néng chū qù wán bì xū zài jiā shuì jiào
items.en: Mom said you must not go out to play after ten at night; you have to be at home asleep.
items.why: A parent's rule means 'not allowed': 不能 + verb. 出不去 would say you are physically unable to get out, and no obstacle is mentioned.

items.q: 这种牛奶已经卖完了，我跑了三家超市也买不___。
items.zh: 这种牛奶已经卖完了，我跑了三家超市也买不到。
items.py: zhè zhǒng niú nǎi yǐ jīng mài wán le wǒ pǎo le sān jiā chāo shì yě mǎi bù dào
items.en: This kind of milk is sold out; I went to three supermarkets and still couldn't get any.
items.why: Sold out means you cannot get hold of it: 买不到. 买不起 is about price, and 买不下 and 买不动 are about room and strength.

items.src_py: wǒ chī de xià zhè ge dà dàn gāo
items.task: Say you are full and cannot eat any more of it (end with 了).
items.zh: 我吃不下这个大蛋糕了。
items.py: wǒ chī bù xià zhè ge dà dàn gāo le
items.en: I can't eat any more of this big cake.
items.why: 下 means room left, and 不 says none is left. 了 marks the change 'not any more' at the very end, after the object.

items.q: 昨天太忙了，我___看到那条短信。
items.zh: 昨天太忙了，我没看到那条短信。
items.py: zuó tiān tài máng le wǒ méi kàn dào nà tiáo duǎn xìn
items.en: I was too busy yesterday and didn't see that text message.
items.why: One occasion in the past: 没 + verb + result. 不 + 看到 does not report a past event, and 能 would say what was possible, not what happened.

items.src: 我今天做完了所有的作业。
items.src_py: wǒ jīn tiān zuò wán le suǒ yǒu de zuò yè
items.task: Say you cannot finish all of it today (potential form).
items.zh: 我今天做不完所有的作业。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zuò bù wán suǒ yǒu de zuò yè
items.en: I can't finish all the homework today.
items.why: Cannot manage = verb + 不 + result, with the object after the whole block (or fronted). 没做完 would only say it did not get finished.

items.s: 奶奶感冒了，周末她来不我们家。
items.s_py: nǎi nai gǎn mào le zhōu mò tā lái bù wǒ men jiā
items.zh: 奶奶感冒了，周末她来不了我们家。
items.py: nǎi nai gǎn mào le zhōu mò tā lái bù liǎo wǒ men jiā
items.en: Grandma has a cold; she can't come to our house at the weekend.
items.why: With no result word the complement is 了 (liǎo): 来不了. Bare 不 cannot be followed straight by the object.

items.zh: 我听不懂售货员的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng shòu huò yuán de huà
items.en: I can't understand what the shop assistant says.
items.why: 不 sits inside the block 听不懂; the object follows the whole block or is fronted as a topic. It cannot go between 听 and 懂.

items.src_py: wǒ men lái de jí chī zǎo fàn
items.task: Say there is no time for it.
items.zh: 我们来不及吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ men lái bù jí chī zǎo fàn
items.en: We don't have time to eat breakfast.
items.why: 来得及 and 来不及 swap 得 and 不, and the verb phrase follows directly. 没来得及 would be a past report, not what the task asks.

items.src_py: rén hěn shǎo wǒ men jìn de qù
items.task: Change it: there are many people, so we can't get in.
items.zh: 人很多，我们进不去。
items.py: rén hěn duō wǒ men jìn bù qù
items.en: There are many people; we can't get in.
items.why: A crowd is an obstacle, so 不 goes between 进 and 去. 不能进去 would say entry is forbidden, which is not the point.

items.q: 这碗汤太辣了，我喝___了。
items.zh: 这碗汤太辣了，我喝不了。
items.py: zhè wǎn tāng tài là le wǒ hē bù liǎo
items.en: This soup is too spicy; I can't drink it.
items.why: Too spicy makes the action impossible for you: 喝不了 (liǎo). 喝得了 would say you can manage it, against the cue.

items.s: 房间太黑了，我们什么也看不见。
items.s_py: fáng jiān tài hēi le wǒ men shén me yě kàn bù jiàn
items.zh: 房间太黑了，我们什么也看不见。
items.py: fáng jiān tài hēi le wǒ men shén me yě kàn bù jiàn
items.en: The room is too dark; we can't see anything.
items.why: A normal potential negative: 不 between 看 and 见, with the reason given by 太黑了.

items.q: 这个包要一万块，你买得___吗？
items.zh: 这个包要一万块，你买得起吗？
items.py: zhè ge bāo yào yī wàn kuài nǐ mǎi de qǐ ma
items.en: This bag costs ten thousand yuan; can you afford it?
items.why: 一万块 raises the question of price, and 起 is the result meaning 'afford'; 得 + 起 stays intact before 吗. 买得动 would ask about carrying strength.

items.q: 这张购物小票上的字太小了，我___看不清楚。
items.zh: 这张购物小票上的字太小了，我看不清楚。
items.py: zhè zhāng gòu wù xiǎo piào shàng de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The writing on this shopping receipt is too small; I can't see it clearly.
items.why: 把 needs an action done to the object, but a potential complement only says whether a result is reachable, so 把 cannot be used. Just say 我看不清楚.

items.src_py: zhè zhǒng wèi dào wǒ shòu de liǎo
items.task: Say you cannot stand this smell.
items.zh: 这种味道我受不了。
items.py: zhè zhǒng wèi dào wǒ shòu bù liǎo
items.en: I can't stand this smell.
items.why: 受 has no result word, so 了 (liǎo) is the complement: 受不了 is the set phrase for 'can't stand'.

items.src_py: zhè ge hàn zì wǒ xiě de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say you cannot write this character well (potential).
items.zh: 这个汉字我写不好。
items.py: zhè ge hàn zì wǒ xiě bù hǎo
items.en: I can't write this character well.
items.why: Unable = 写不好: 得 is replaced by 不 and 很 disappears. 写得不好 would only judge the writing as poor.

items.q: 这么多菜，你们吃得完吗？我们人多，___。
items.zh: 这么多菜，你们吃得完吗？我们人多，吃得完。
items.py: zhè me duō cài nǐ men chī de wán ma wǒ men rén duō chī de wán
items.en: So many dishes; can you finish them? We're a big group, so yes.
items.why: Answer a potential question by repeating the potential form: 吃得完. 是 answers a different kind of question, and 吃不了 would deny it, against 人多.

items.zh: 这么多东西你一个人拿得了吗？
items.py: zhè me duō dōng xi nǐ yī ge rén ná de liǎo ma
items.en: Can you carry this many things by yourself?
items.why: 拿得了 stays together as the positive potential and 吗 ends the question. The object goes in front or after the block.

items.q: 妈妈做的菜很好吃，朋友们都说她菜做___很好。
items.zh: 妈妈做的菜很好吃，朋友们都说她菜做得很好。
items.py: mā ma zuò de cài hěn hǎo chī péng you men dōu shuō tā cài zuò de hěn hǎo
items.en: Mom's cooking is delicious; her friends all say she cooks very well.
items.why: 做得很好 judges how well she cooks, and only the degree 得 allows 很. A potential 不 would say she is unable to cook well.

items.q: 这么多衣服，我一个晚上___洗不完。
items.zh: 这么多衣服，我一个晚上洗不完。
items.py: zhè me duō yī fu wǒ yī ge wǎn shang xǐ bù wán
items.en: I can't wash this many clothes in one evening.
items.why: A potential complement does not combine with 把; the clothes stay in front as a topic and 洗不完 follows the subject and time.

items.src: 我把这么多衣服洗完了。
items.src_py: wǒ bǎ zhè me duō yī fu xǐ wán le
items.task: Say you cannot wash this many clothes today (no 把).
items.zh: 这么多衣服我今天洗不完。
items.py: zhè me duō yī fu wǒ jīn tiān xǐ bù wán
items.en: I can't finish washing this many clothes today.
items.why: A potential complement never takes 把; drop it and either front the object or put it after 洗不完. 了 is not added.

items.q: 这袋米有二十公斤，我一个人拿___动。
items.zh: 这袋米有二十公斤，我一个人拿不动。
items.py: zhè dài mǐ yǒu èr shí gōng jīn wǒ yī ge rén ná bù dòng
items.en: This bag of rice weighs twenty kilos; I can't lift it by myself.
items.why: 动 as a result means 'able to move it by strength'; 二十公斤 and 一个人 point to failure, so 不. 拿得动 would say you can.

items.s: 这个包很贵，你买得起吗？
items.s_py: zhè ge bāo hěn guì nǐ mǎi de qǐ ma
items.zh: 这个包很贵，你买得起吗？
items.py: zhè ge bāo hěn guì nǐ mǎi de qǐ ma
items.en: This bag is expensive; can you afford it?
items.why: 吗 can be added directly to a positive potential. The question keeps 买得起 whole and 吗 closes the sentence.

items.q: 弟弟晚上喝了咖啡，到现在还睡___着。
items.zh: 弟弟晚上喝了咖啡，到现在还睡不着。
items.py: dì di wǎn shang hē le kā fēi dào xiàn zài hái shuì bù zháo
items.en: My brother drank coffee in the evening and still can't fall asleep.
items.why: 睡着 (zháo) 'fall asleep' takes 不 when you cannot manage it, and the coffee is the reason. 睡得着 would say he can sleep, against 到现在还.

items.q: 灯关了，我看___见爸爸的眼镜。
items.zh: 灯关了，我看不见爸爸的眼镜。
items.py: dēng guān le wǒ kàn bù jiàn bà ba de yǎn jìng
items.en: The light is off, so I can't see Dad's glasses.
items.why: With the light off the result 见 cannot be reached, so 不 goes between 看 and 见 and the object follows the whole block. 看得见 would say you can see them.

items.s: 昨天的电影我没看得懂。
items.s_py: zuó tiān de diàn yǐng wǒ méi kàn de dǒng
items.zh: 昨天的电影我没看懂。
items.py: zuó tiān de diàn yǐng wǒ méi kàn dǒng
items.en: I didn't understand yesterday's film.
items.why: 没 negates a plain verb + result (没看懂), not a potential with 得. Use 没看懂 for 'did not' or 看不懂 for 'cannot'.

items.s: 售货员问的问题，我回答不了。
items.s_py: shòu huò yuán wèn de wèn tí wǒ huí dá bù liǎo
items.zh: 售货员问的问题，我回答不了。
items.py: shòu huò yuán wèn de wèn tí wǒ huí dá bù liǎo
items.en: I can't answer the question the shop assistant asked.
items.why: The object is fronted as a topic and the verb takes 不了. No 把 is needed, and the sentence is correct.

items.s: 这个字太难了，弟弟怎么写也写不好。
items.s_py: zhè ge zì tài nán le dì di zěn me xiě yě xiě bù hǎo
items.zh: 这个字太难了，弟弟怎么写也写不好。
items.py: zhè ge zì tài nán le dì di zěn me xiě yě xiě bù hǎo
items.en: This character is too hard; my brother can't write it well however he tries.
items.why: Inability is potential 写不好, not 写得不好, and it takes no 很. The reason clause 太难了 matches.

items.src_py: nǐ tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 你听得见我说话吗？
items.py: nǐ tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà ma
items.en: Can you hear me talking?
items.why: A yes/no question keeps the potential form as it is and adds 吗 at the end; nothing is inserted inside 听得见.

items.q: 这个书包太重了，我背___动。
items.zh: 这个书包太重了，我背不动。
items.py: zhè ge shū bāo tài zhòng le wǒ bēi bù dòng
items.en: This schoolbag is too heavy; I can't carry it on my back.
items.why: Too heavy is a physical limit: 不 between 背 and 动. 背得动 would say you can carry it, against 太重了.

items.q: 电影八点开始，都七点五十五了，我们去电影院已经来___及了。
items.zh: 电影八点开始，都七点五十五了，我们去电影院已经来不及了。
items.py: diàn yǐng bā diǎn kāi shǐ dōu qī diǎn wǔ shí wǔ le wǒ men qù diàn yǐng yuàn yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
items.en: The film starts at eight and it's already five to eight; it's too late for us to go to the cinema.
items.why: Five minutes before the start leaves no time: 来不及 'too late'. 来得及 would say there is still time, against the cue.

items.src_py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu
items.task: Say that he does not speak clearly (a judgment on how he speaks).
items.zh: 他说得不清楚。
items.py: tā shuō de bù qīng chu
items.en: He doesn't speak clearly.
items.why: To judge how someone speaks keep the degree 得 and negate the adjective: 说得不清楚. 说不清楚 would say he is unable to explain.

items.s: 我想不起来了弟弟的生日。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái le dì di de shēng rì
items.zh: 我想不起来弟弟的生日了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái dì di de shēng rì le
items.en: I can't remember my brother's birthday any more.
items.why: The 了 meaning 'any more' goes at the end, after the object. Placed between 起来 and the object it breaks the sentence.

items.zh: 这是别人的车，你不能开走。
items.py: zhè shì bié rén de chē nǐ bù néng kāi zǒu
items.en: This is someone else's car; you can't drive it away.
items.why: A rule about another person's property is 不能 + verb, placed before 开走. 开不走 would say the car is broken or you lack the ability.

items.src_py: zhè ge dōng xi nǐ bù néng ná zǒu
items.task: Say you are physically unable to carry it off (potential).
items.zh: 这个东西你拿不走。
items.py: zhè ge dōng xi nǐ ná bù zǒu
items.en: You can't carry this thing off.
items.why: 'Unable' is verb + 不 + result, with 不 inside the block after 拿. 不能拿走 gives a prohibition instead.

items.q: 门口的人太多了，我们怎么也___进去。
items.zh: 门口的人太多了，我们怎么也挤不进去。
items.py: mén kǒu de rén tài duō le wǒ men zěn me yě jǐ bù jìn qù
items.en: There are too many people at the door; we can't squeeze in no matter what.
items.why: A crowd is a physical obstacle: 挤不进去 'cannot squeeze in'. 不能挤 would be a ban, and 挤得进去 would say it works.

items.q: 我想了很久，还是想___起来那家玩具店的名字。
items.zh: 我想了很久，还是想不起来那家玩具店的名字。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ hái shi xiǎng bù qǐ lái nà jiā wán jù diàn de míng zi
items.en: I thought for a long time and still can't remember the name of that toy shop.
items.why: 想不起来 is the set way to say 'cannot recall'. 还是 after a long think shows the failure goes on, so 不, not 得; the object follows the whole block.

items.zh: 商场九点关门，现在去已经来不及了。
items.py: shāng chǎng jiǔ diǎn guān mén xiàn zài qù yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
items.en: The mall closes at nine; it's already too late to go now.
items.why: The reason clause comes first; then 来不及 'too late' follows 已经 and takes the final 了.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn dǒng le zhè fēng xìn
items.task: Say you did not understand it (one occasion), using 没.
items.zh: 我没看懂这封信。
items.py: wǒ méi kàn dǒng zhè fēng xìn
items.en: I didn't understand this letter.
items.why: 没 + verb + result negates a completed occasion, and 了 drops out. 不 would not report a past event.

items.q: 这件衣服两千块，太贵了，我买___起。
items.zh: 这件衣服两千块，太贵了，我买不起。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu liǎng qiān kuài tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: This piece of clothing costs two thousand yuan; it's too expensive and I can't afford it.
items.why: 起 after 买 means 'afford'; 太贵了 puts the price out of reach, so 不. 买得起 would say it is affordable, which contradicts the cue.

items.q: 我把家里翻了个遍，那张购物卡还是找___到。
items.zh: 我把家里翻了个遍，那张购物卡还是找不到。
items.py: wǒ bǎ jiā lǐ fān le ge biàn nà zhāng gòu wù kǎ hái shi zhǎo bù dào
items.en: I turned the whole house upside down and still can't find that shopping card.
items.why: 还是 after a long search shows the failure continues, so 不 between 找 and 到. 得 would say you can find it, against the cue; 找没到 is not a form.

items.q: 这是妹妹的玩具，你___拿走。
items.zh: 这是妹妹的玩具，你不能拿走。
items.py: zhè shì mèi mei de wán jù nǐ bù néng ná zǒu
items.en: This is my sister's toy; you can't take it away.
items.why: Someone else's property is a rule, not an ability problem, so 不能 + verb. 拿不走 would say you physically cannot manage it, which is not the point.

items.src: 这袋米很轻，妹妹一个人拿得动。
items.src_py: zhè dài mǐ hěn qīng mèi mei yī ge rén ná de dòng
items.task: Change it: the bag is heavy and she cannot lift it.
items.zh: 这袋米很重，妹妹一个人拿不动。
items.py: zhè dài mǐ hěn zhòng mèi mei yī ge rén ná bù dòng
items.en: The bag of rice is heavy; my sister can't lift it by herself.
items.why: Both parts flip: 重 gives the reason and 动 takes 不 for inability. The cause clause stays before the result clause.

items.q: 爷爷的腿不好，六楼他爬___上去。
items.zh: 爷爷的腿不好，六楼他爬不上去。
items.py: yé ye de tuǐ bù hǎo liù lóu tā pá bù shàng qù
items.en: Grandpa's legs are bad; he can't climb up to the sixth floor.
items.why: Bad legs make the climb impossible: 不 between 爬 and 上去. 爬得上去 would say he can, which contradicts 腿不好.

items.src_py: mèi mei néng kàn dǒng zhè běn shū
items.task: Say she cannot understand it (potential form).
items.zh: 这本书妹妹看不懂。
items.py: zhè běn shū mèi mei kàn bù dǒng
items.en: My sister can't understand this book.
items.why: To say she is unable, drop 能 and put 不 between 看 and 懂; the object may stand in front as a topic. 把 cannot be used and 不能看懂 is not the form.

items.zh: 这件羽绒服我买不起。
items.py: zhè jiàn yǔ róng fú wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: I can't afford this down jacket.
items.why: 买不起 'cannot afford' is one block with 不 inside it. The object is fronted as a topic or placed after the whole block.

items.q: 我刚吃了很多，现在吃___下了。
items.zh: 我刚吃了很多，现在吃不下了。
items.py: wǒ gāng chī le hěn duō xiàn zài chī bù xià le
items.en: I just ate a lot; I can't eat any more now.
items.why: 吃不下 means there is no room left; 刚吃了很多 is the reason, so 不. 吃得下 would mean there is still room, against the cue.

items.src: 我们三个人吃完了这么多菜。
items.src_py: wǒ men sān ge rén chī wán le zhè me duō cài
items.task: Say the three of you cannot finish so many dishes (use 吃不了).
items.zh: 这么多菜我们三个人吃不了。
items.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men sān ge rén chī bù liǎo
items.en: The three of us can't eat this many dishes.
items.why: Too much to finish and no specific result word: 吃不了 (liǎo). 没吃完 would only report what happened, not inability.

items.q: 沙发太高了，小弟弟自己爬不___去。
items.zh: 沙发太高了，小弟弟自己爬不上去。
items.py: shā fā tài gāo le xiǎo dì di zì jǐ pá bù shàng qù
items.en: The sofa is too high for little brother to climb up on by himself.
items.why: The direction word must match the movement: up onto a high sofa is 上. 爬不下去 would mean he cannot climb down, which is not the situation.

items.q: 箱子太大，门太小，我们搬___进去。
items.zh: 箱子太大，门太小，我们搬不进去。
items.py: xiāng zi tài dà mén tài xiǎo wǒ men bān bù jìn qù
items.en: The box is too big and the door too small; we can't carry it in.
items.why: A size obstacle means failure, so 不 goes between 搬 and the direction 进去. 搬得进去 would say it fits, and 搬能进去 is not a form.

items.s: 我把这张价格表看不懂。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè zhāng jià gé biǎo kàn bù dǒng
items.zh: 这张价格表我看不懂。
items.py: zhè zhāng jià gé biǎo wǒ kàn bù dǒng
items.en: I can't understand this price list.
items.why: 把 needs an action done to the object, but a potential only says whether the result is reachable. Front the object as a topic instead.

items.zh: 医生说爷爷现在不能吃甜的。
items.py: yī shēng shuō yé ye xiàn zài bù néng chī tián de
items.en: The doctor says Grandpa mustn't eat sweet things now.
items.why: A doctor's instruction means not allowed: 不能 goes directly before the verb 吃. A potential complement would say he is unable.

items.q: 妈妈做了一大桌菜，我们三个人怎么也吃不___。
items.zh: 妈妈做了一大桌菜，我们三个人怎么也吃不完。
items.py: mā ma zuò le yī dà zhuō cài wǒ men sān ge rén zěn me yě chī bù wán
items.en: Mom cooked a whole table of dishes; the three of us can't possibly finish them.
items.why: A huge amount of food that cannot be finished is 吃不完. 吃不起 is about money, and 吃不到 and 吃不见 are not about quantity.

items.q: 你看___看得懂这本说明书？
items.zh: 你看不看得懂这本说明书？
items.py: nǐ kàn bù kàn de dǒng zhè běn shuō míng shū
items.en: Can you understand this instruction manual?
items.why: V不V得R: only the verb repeats, with 不 between, giving 看不看得懂. 看没看得懂 and 看得看得懂 are not forms, and 吗 is not added.

items.q: 外面雨太大，我什么都看___见。
items.zh: 外面雨太大，我什么都看不见。
items.py: wài miàn yǔ tài dà wǒ shén me dōu kàn bù jiàn
items.en: The rain outside is so heavy that I can't see anything.
items.why: The heavy rain is the reason for failing, so 不 goes between 看 and 见. 得 would say you can see, contradicting 什么都; 没 never sits inside verb + result.

items.q: 我鼻子堵住了，什么味道都闻___到。
items.zh: 我鼻子堵住了，什么味道都闻不到。
items.py: wǒ bí zi dǔ zhù le shén me wèi dao dōu wén bù dào
items.en: My nose is blocked; I can't smell anything.
items.why: A blocked nose means the smell cannot be reached: 闻不到. 闻得到 would claim you can smell, and 很 cannot be inserted inside a potential form.

items.q: 雾这么大，前面的路我看___清楚。
items.zh: 雾这么大，前面的路我看不清楚。
items.py: wù zhè me dà qián miàn de lù wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The fog is so thick that I can't see the road ahead clearly.
items.why: Thick fog explains the inability, so 看不清楚. 看得清楚 says the opposite; 没 and 很 cannot stand between the verb and its result in a potential form.

items.q: 雪停了，路上的车终于开___动了。
items.zh: 雪停了，路上的车终于开得动了。
items.py: xuě tíng le lù shàng de chē zhōng yú kāi de dòng le
items.en: The snow has stopped, and the cars can finally move again.
items.why: 终于 and 雪停了 report that the obstacle is gone, so the positive 开得动 fits. 开不动 would mean they still cannot move; 没 and 很 do not fit between verb and result.

items.q: 医生说的话，我一句也没听___。
items.zh: 医生说的话，我一句也没听懂。
items.py: yī shēng shuō de huà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng dǒng
items.en: I didn't understand a single sentence the doctor said.
items.why: 没 reports that one occasion did not succeed, so it takes bare verb + result: 没听懂. 没 cannot be combined with 得 or 不 (没听不懂), and 听不了 is a different meaning.

items.q: 我太累了，爬___上去了。
items.zh: 我太累了，爬不上去了。
items.py: wǒ tài lèi le pá bù shàng qù le
items.en: I'm too tired; I can't climb up any more.
items.why: Exhaustion is the obstacle, so 不 goes right after 爬: 爬不上去. 爬得上去 would say you can still manage it, which clashes with 太累了.

items.q: 我的腿受伤了，站___起来。
items.zh: 我的腿受伤了，站不起来。
items.py: wǒ de tuǐ shòu shāng le zhàn bù qǐ lái
items.en: My leg is injured and I can't stand up.
items.why: An injured leg is a physical obstacle: 站不起来. 站得起来 says the opposite, and 不能 cannot sit between 站 and 起来.

items.q: 年纪大了，他的名字我怎么也想___起来了。
items.zh: 年纪大了，他的名字我怎么也想不起来了。
items.py: nián jì dà le tā de míng zi wǒ zěn me yě xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
items.en: I'm getting old; I just can't recall his name any more.
items.why: 怎么也 plus an age-related memory loss needs the negative 想不起来. 想得起来 would be positive and contradicts 怎么也, and 没 cannot split 想 from 起来.

items.q: 别担心，这点雨不大，我们走___回去。
items.zh: 别担心，这点雨不大，我们走得回去。
items.py: bié dān xīn zhè diǎn yǔ bù dà wǒ men zǒu de huí qù
