items.en: Don't worry, this rain isn't heavy; we can walk back.
items.why: The reassurance 别担心 and 雨不大 call for the positive 走得回去. 走不回去 would say they cannot, which contradicts the comfort being offered.

items.q: 风太大了，我们的帐篷怎么也搭___起来。
items.zh: 风太大了，我们的帐篷怎么也搭不起来。
items.py: fēng tài dà le wǒ men de zhàng peng zěn me yě dā bù qǐ lái
items.en: The wind is so strong that we just can't get our tent up.
items.why: A strong wind is a physical obstacle: 搭不起来. 搭得起来 contradicts 怎么也, and 不能搭起来 would sound like a ban instead of a failed attempt.

items.q: 我肚子疼，一口饭也吃___。
items.zh: 我肚子疼，一口饭也吃不下。
items.py: wǒ dù zi téng yī kǒu fàn yě chī bù xià
items.en: My stomach hurts; I can't get down a single bite.
items.why: 下 in the potential means room or ability to take food in, so 吃不下. 吃不起 means cannot afford it, and 吃不到 means cannot get hold of it.

items.q: 已经七点五十了，八点的飞机，现在去机场___了。
items.zh: 已经七点五十了，八点的飞机，现在去机场来不及了。
items.py: yǐ jīng qī diǎn wǔ shí le bā diǎn de fēi jī xiàn zài qù jī chǎng lái bù jí le
items.en: It is already ten to eight and the flight is at eight; it's too late to go to the airport now.
items.why: Only ten minutes left before takeoff, so there is no time: 来不及. 来得及 says there is time, 来不了 says you cannot come, and 对不起 is an apology.

items.q: 你别急，现在出门还___。
items.zh: 你别急，现在出门还来得及。
items.py: nǐ bié jí xiàn zài chū mén hái lái de jí
items.en: Don't worry; if you leave now there is still time.
items.why: 别急 means there is still time, so 还来得及. 来不及 says it is too late, 来不了 means unable to come, and 来得了 is not the time expression.

items.q: 天气预报说一小时后会下大雨，我们现在跑回家还___。
items.zh: 天气预报说一小时后会下大雨，我们现在跑回家还来得及。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō yī xiǎo shí hòu huì xià dà yǔ wǒ men xiàn zài pǎo huí jiā hái lái de jí
items.en: The forecast says heavy rain in an hour; if we run home now we can still make it.
items.why: An hour of margin means there is enough time: 还来得及. 来不及 would say it is too late, and 来得了 asks about ability rather than time.

items.q: 冬天的大衣太贵了，他买___。
items.zh: 冬天的大衣太贵了，他买不起。
items.py: dōng tiān de dà yī tài guì le tā mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: Winter coats are too expensive; he can't afford one.
items.why: 太贵 gives the reason: the price is beyond his budget, so 买不起. 买不到 would mean none are on sale, and 买不下 has no such meaning.

items.q: 空调都卖完了，我们哪儿都买___。
items.zh: 空调都卖完了，我们哪儿都买不到。
items.py: kōng tiáo dōu mài wán le wǒ men nǎ r dōu mǎi bù dào
items.en: The air conditioners are all sold out; we can't buy one anywhere.
items.why: 卖完了 means none are available, so 买不到. 买不起 is about price, and the others are not set forms with 买.

items.q: 晚上咖啡喝多了，我怎么也睡___。
items.zh: 晚上咖啡喝多了，我怎么也睡不着。
items.py: wǎn shang kā fēi hē duō le wǒ zěn me yě shuì bù zháo
items.en: I drank too much coffee in the evening and can't fall asleep no matter what.
items.why: 睡不着 (zháo) is the set form for being unable to fall asleep. 睡不下, 睡不起 and 睡不动 are not used for insomnia.

items.q: 我刚吃完饭，再好吃的蛋糕也吃___了。
items.zh: 我刚吃完饭，再好吃的蛋糕也吃不下了。
items.py: wǒ gāng chī wán fàn zài hǎo chī de dàn gāo yě chī bù xià le
items.en: I just finished eating; I couldn't manage any more, however nice the cake.
items.why: 刚吃完饭 means the stomach has no room left: 吃不下. 吃不完 is about a large amount that cannot be finished, and 吃不起 is about price.

items.q: 这个西瓜太大了，我们三个人吃两天也吃___。
items.zh: 这个西瓜太大了，我们三个人吃两天也吃不完。
items.py: zhè ge xī guā tài dà le wǒ men sān ge rén chī liǎng tiān yě chī bù wán
items.en: This watermelon is so big that three of us couldn't finish it in two days.
items.why: Too much food to finish is 吃不完. 吃不起 would be about money, 吃不到 about getting hold of it, and 吃不动 is not said of food.

items.q: 明天下大雪，我们去___。
items.zh: 明天下大雪，我们去不了。
items.py: míng tiān xià dà xuě wǒ men qù bù liǎo
items.en: It's going to snow heavily tomorrow, so we can't go.
items.why: 去 has no result word, so inability is 去不了 (liǎo). 去不到 needs a destination to reach, 去不起 means cannot afford, and 去不下 means no room.

items.q: 我胃不好，太辣的菜我吃___。
items.zh: 我胃不好，太辣的菜我吃不了。
items.py: wǒ wèi bù hǎo tài là de cài wǒ chī bù liǎo
items.en: My stomach is bad; I can't eat very spicy food.
items.why: With no specific result, 吃不了 says the action cannot be done. 吃不起 would be about price, which has nothing to do with a bad stomach.

items.q: 今年冬天太冷了，我真受___。
items.zh: 今年冬天太冷了，我真受不了。
items.py: jīn nián dōng tiān tài lěng le wǒ zhēn shòu bù liǎo
items.en: This winter is so cold that I really can't stand it.
items.why: 受不了 (liǎo) is the set phrase for can't stand. 受不起 means cannot bear an honour or a favour, so it does not fit complaining about cold.

items.q: 下雨天路滑，山路根本走___，还是别去了。
items.zh: 下雨天路滑，山路根本走不了，还是别去了。
items.py: xià yǔ tiān lù huá shān lù gēn běn zǒu bù liǎo hái shi bié qù le
items.en: The road is slippery in the rain and the mountain path is impossible to walk; let's not go.
items.why: The slippery road makes walking impossible, with no result word to name: 走不了. 走不起 and 走不下 do not have this meaning.

items.q: 那年冬天的第一场雪，我永远忘___。
items.zh: 那年冬天的第一场雪，我永远忘不了。
items.py: nà nián dōng tiān de dì yī chǎng xuě wǒ yǒng yuǎn wàng bù liǎo
items.en: I will never forget the first snow of that winter.
items.why: 忘不了 (liǎo) is the fixed phrase for cannot forget. 忘不到, 忘不起 and 忘不下 do not exist.

items.q: 明天的会，你去得___吗？
items.zh: 明天的会，你去得了吗？
items.py: míng tiān de huì nǐ qù de liǎo ma
items.en: Can you make it to tomorrow's meeting?
items.why: With no result word and no price or space involved, ability to do the action at all is V得了 (liǎo) in a question. 去得起 would be about affording it, 去得下 has no such meaning, and 去得到 is about reaching a place.

items.q: 医生说你感冒了，今天___去游泳。
items.zh: 医生说你感冒了，今天不能去游泳。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ gǎn mào le jīn tiān bù néng qù yóu yǒng
items.en: The doctor says you have a cold, so you must not go swimming today.
items.why: 医生说 gives an instruction, so it is 不能 + verb (not allowed). 不了, 不起 and 不到 are complements and cannot stand before 去.

items.q: 病人刚睡着，你们___大声说话。
items.zh: 病人刚睡着，你们不能大声说话。
items.py: bìng rén gāng shuì zháo nǐ men bù néng dà shēng shuō huà
items.en: The patient has just fallen asleep; you mustn't talk loudly.
items.why: This is a request to refrain, not an inability, so 不能 + verb. A complement like 不了 cannot go before 大声说话.

items.q: 这个箱子里装满了书，太重了，我一个人搬___。
items.zh: 这个箱子里装满了书，太重了，我一个人搬不动。
items.py: zhè ge xiāng zi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shū tài zhòng le wǒ yī ge rén bān bù dòng
items.en: This box is full of books and too heavy; I can't lift it by myself.
items.why: Heaviness is a physical obstacle, so 搬不动. 搬不能 and 搬没动 are not forms, and 搬不下 is not used for weight.

items.q: 医生说你的腿还没好，现在___爬山。
items.zh: 医生说你的腿还没好，现在不能爬山。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ de tuǐ hái méi hǎo xiàn zài bù néng pá shān
items.en: The doctor says your leg isn't better yet, so you shouldn't climb mountains now.
items.why: The doctor is giving advice about what you should not do: 不能 + verb. Complements such as 不了 or 不动 cannot be placed before 爬山.

items.q: 他的腿骨折了，现在站___，更不用说走路了。
items.zh: 他的腿骨折了，现在站不起来，更不用说走路了。
items.py: tā de tuǐ gǔ zhé le xiàn zài zhàn bù qǐ lái gèng bù yòng shuō zǒu lù le
items.en: His leg is broken; he can't even stand up now, let alone walk.
items.why: A broken leg is a physical obstacle, so 站不起来. 不能起来 is not the complement form, 没起来 would report one occasion, and 不上来 has the wrong direction.

items.q: 台风来了，学校通知今天___出门。
items.zh: 台风来了，学校通知今天不能出门。
items.py: tái fēng lái le xué xiào tōng zhī jīn tiān bù néng chū mén
items.en: A typhoon is coming; the school has notified everyone not to go out today.
items.why: A school notice is an instruction, so 不能 + verb. 不了 and the other complements cannot stand directly before 出门.

items.q: 这里是病房，晚上八点以后外人___进去。
items.zh: 这里是病房，晚上八点以后外人不能进去。
items.py: zhè lǐ shì bìng fáng wǎn shang bā diǎn yǐ hòu wài rén bù néng jìn qù
items.en: This is a ward; outsiders may not go in after eight at night.
items.why: A visiting rule forbids entry, so 不能 + 进去. The potential 进不去 would say outsiders physically cannot get in, not that it is against the rules.

items.q: 他的汉字写___很好，老师很喜欢。
items.zh: 他的汉字写得很好，老师很喜欢。
items.py: tā de hàn zì xiě de hěn hǎo lǎo shī hěn xǐ huan
items.en: He writes Chinese characters very well, and the teacher likes them.
items.why: 很 shows this is the degree 得 (how well he writes). A potential form never takes 很, so 不 and 没 cannot fit.

items.q: 昨天雨太大，路灯又坏了，司机开车开___很慢。
items.zh: 昨天雨太大，路灯又坏了，司机开车开得很慢。
items.py: zuó tiān yǔ tài dà lù dēng yòu huài le sī jī kāi chē kāi de hěn màn
items.en: Yesterday the rain was heavy and the street lights were out, so the driver drove very slowly.
items.why: 开得很慢 describes how he drove (degree 得 with 很). 开不很慢 and 开没很慢 are not forms; the potential never takes 很.

items.q: 我今天嗓子哑了，再怎么用力也唱___好。
items.zh: 我今天嗓子哑了，再怎么用力也唱不好。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān sǎng zi yǎ le zài zěn me yòng lì yě chàng bù hǎo
items.en: My throat is hoarse today, so I can't sing well however hard I try.
items.why: 再怎么…也 describes failing to reach a result, so the potential 唱不好 is needed. 得很 is the degree pattern and 唱得好 contradicts the sentence.

items.q: 这本医学书太难了，我___看不懂。
items.zh: 这本医学书太难了，我看不懂。
items.py: zhè běn yī xué shū tài nán le wǒ kàn bù dǒng
items.en: This medical book is too hard; I can't understand it.
items.why: A potential complement says only whether something is possible, so 把 cannot be used with it. 被 and 对 do not make a sentence here either.

items.q: 他说得太快，他的话我___。
items.zh: 他说得太快，他的话我听不懂。
items.py: tā shuō de tài kuài tā de huà wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand what he says.
items.why: With the object fronted as a topic, the verb block 听不懂 stands whole at the end. 听他不懂 splits it, 不听懂 puts 不 before the verb, and 听得很懂 contradicts 太快.

items.q: 风声太大了，你听___见我说话吗？
items.zh: 风声太大了，你听得见我说话吗？
items.py: fēng shēng tài dà le nǐ tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà ma
items.en: The wind is loud; can you hear me?
items.why: A yes/no question with 吗 uses the positive form 听得见. 没 and 很 cannot stand inside verb + result.

items.q: 雨这么大，你走___走得回去？
items.zh: 雨这么大，你走不走得回去？
items.py: yǔ zhè me dà nǐ zǒu bù zǒu de huí qù
items.en: The rain is so heavy; can you walk back?
items.why: V不V得R repeats the verb: 走不走得回去. 得 or 很 in the first slot would not make a question, and the verb itself must be repeated.

items.q: 老师，这么多新词，我们一个晚上记___记得住？
items.zh: 老师，这么多新词，我们一个晚上记不记得住？
items.py: lǎo shī zhè me duō xīn cí wǒ men yī ge wǎn shang jì bù jì de zhù
items.en: Teacher, can we remember this many new words in one evening?
items.why: The colloquial A-not-A question repeats the verb: 记不记得住. 得, 能 or 很 in that slot does not form a question.

items.q: 外面太吵，朋友问我听得见吗，我说听___见。
items.zh: 外面太吵，朋友问我听得见吗，我说听不见。
items.py: wài miàn tài chǎo péng you wèn wǒ tīng de jiàn ma wǒ shuō tīng bù jiàn
items.en: It was too noisy; my friend asked if I could hear, and I said I couldn't.
items.why: The answer repeats the potential form, and the noise says it is the negative: 听不见. 是 and 不是 cannot answer a potential question.

items.q: 这个药的说明这么小，你看得清楚看___清楚？
items.zh: 这个药的说明这么小，你看得清楚看不清楚？
items.py: zhè ge yào de shuō míng zhè me xiǎo nǐ kàn de qīng chu kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The instructions on this medicine are so small; can you read them clearly or not?
items.why: The positive + negative question needs the full pair 看得清楚看不清楚. Putting 没, 得 or 很 in the second slot does not give the negative pair.

items.q: 他的病这么重，明天来得了来___？
items.zh: 他的病这么重，明天来得了来不了？
items.py: tā de bìng zhè me zhòng míng tiān lái de liǎo lái bù liǎo
items.en: He is so ill; can he come tomorrow or not?
items.why: The pair must be complete: 来得了来不了. 来不得 and 来没了 are not forms, and 吗 cannot finish an A-not-A pair.

items.q: 外面这么吵，你睡得___吗？
items.zh: 外面这么吵，你睡得着吗？
items.py: wài miàn zhè me chǎo nǐ shuì de zháo ma
items.en: It's so noisy outside; can you get to sleep?
items.why: 睡得着 (zháo) is the potential form for being able to fall asleep. 起, 懂 and 见 are not the result of 睡.

items.zh: 我听不懂医生的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng yī shēng de huà
items.en: I can't understand what the doctor says.
items.why: The object goes after the whole 听不懂 block, or in front as a topic. It cannot split 听 and 不懂.

items.zh: 雨太大了，我们回不去了。
items.py: yǔ tài dà le wǒ men huí bù qù le
items.en: The rain is too heavy; we can't get back.
items.why: The reason clause comes first, then the subject and 回不去了. 不 sits between 回 and 去, and the sentence-final 了 closes the block.

items.zh: 这么冷的天，你睡得着睡不着？
items.py: zhè me lěng de tiān nǐ shuì de zháo shuì bù zháo
items.en: In such cold weather, can you sleep or not?
items.why: The positive and negative potential forms stand side by side with no 吗. The time phrase may come before or after 你.

items.zh: 吃药的时候不能喝酒。
items.py: chī yào de shí hou bù néng hē jiǔ
items.en: You must not drink alcohol while taking medicine.
items.why: A medical instruction is 不能 + verb (not allowed). The time clause comes first, and 不能 stands directly before 喝酒.

items.zh: 这么多水，我一次喝不了。
items.py: zhè me duō shuǐ wǒ yī cì hē bù liǎo
items.en: I can't drink this much water at one time.
items.why: Too much to manage is V不了 (liǎo). The object can be a topic in front or follow 喝不了, but 不了 cannot be separated from 喝.

items.zh: 手冻僵了，字我写不好。
items.py: shǒu dòng jiāng le zì wǒ xiě bù hǎo
items.en: My hands are frozen stiff; I can't write the characters well.
items.why: The stiff hands are why the result cannot be reached, so the potential 写不好 is used, with 字 fronted or after the block.

items.zh: 我买不起这副眼镜。
items.py: wǒ mǎi bù qǐ zhè fù yǎn jìng
items.en: I can't afford these glasses.
items.why: 买不起 is the set form for cannot afford; the object follows it or is fronted as a topic, and 不起 stays attached to 买.

items.zh: 雾太大了，我看不见前面。
items.py: wù tài dà le wǒ kàn bù jiàn qián miàn
items.en: The fog is so thick that I can't see ahead.
items.why: 不 sits between 看 and 见, and 前面 follows the block (or is fronted as a topic).

items.zh: 这些药我吃不完。
items.py: zhè xiē yào wǒ chī bù wán
items.en: I can't finish all these pills.
items.why: 吃不完 is one block; the object may be fronted, follow the subject, or follow the block, but never sit between 吃 and 不完.

items.zh: 医生说你现在不能吃辣的。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ xiàn zài bù néng chī là de
items.en: The doctor says you can't eat spicy food right now.
items.why: The doctor's instruction is not-allowed, so 不能 + verb. The time word stands before 不能, either before or after 你.

items.src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le wǒ de sǎn
items.task: Say you cannot find it.
items.zh: 我找不到我的伞。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de sǎn
items.en: I can't find my umbrella.
items.why: Inability is 不 between verb and result: 找不到. The 了 of the completed action goes away, and the object follows the block or is fronted.

items.src: 他的声音很大，我听得见。
items.src_py: tā de shēng yīn hěn dà wǒ tīng de jiàn
items.task: Say his voice is too quiet, so you cannot hear.
items.zh: 他的声音太小，我听不见。
items.py: tā de shēng yīn tài xiǎo wǒ tīng bù jiàn
items.en: His voice is too quiet; I can't hear him.
items.why: Flip 得 to 不: 听不见. The reason clause 他的声音太小 explains why the result cannot be reached.

items.src_py: yǔ tíng le wǒ men zǒu de huí qù
items.task: It is still raining: say you cannot walk back.
items.zh: 雨还在下，我们走不回去。
items.py: yǔ hái zài xià wǒ men zǒu bù huí qù
items.en: It's still raining; we can't walk back.
items.why: The ongoing rain is the obstacle, so 得 becomes 不 right after 走: 走不回去.

items.src: 这个沙发很小，我们搬得进去。
items.src_py: zhè ge shā fā hěn xiǎo wǒ men bān de jìn qù
items.task: Say it is too big to be moved in.
items.zh: 这个沙发太大了，我们搬不进去。
items.py: zhè ge shā fā tài dà le wǒ men bān bù jìn qù
items.en: This sofa is too big; we can't move it in.
items.why: 搬得进去 becomes 搬不进去 once the sofa is too big. 不 goes between 搬 and 进去, not before 搬.

items.src: 这双靴子很便宜，我买得起。
items.src_py: zhè shuāng xuē zi hěn pián yi wǒ mǎi de qǐ
items.task: Say it is too expensive, so you cannot afford it.
items.zh: 这双靴子太贵了，我买不起。
items.py: zhè shuāng xuē zi tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: These boots are too expensive; I can't afford them.
items.why: Price beyond reach is 买不起; 起 here means afford, and 不 replaces 得.

items.src_py: xiàn zài qù yī yuàn hái lái de jí
items.task: Say it is already too late.
items.zh: 现在去医院已经来不及了。
items.py: xiàn zài qù yī yuàn yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
items.en: It is already too late to go to the hospital now.
items.why: 来得及 becomes 来不及 for no time left, with 已经 and a closing 了 marking the change.

items.src_py: wǒ míng tiān qù xué xiào
items.task: Say you cannot go (you are ill).
items.zh: 我明天去不了学校。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān qù bù liǎo xué xiào
items.en: I can't go to school tomorrow.
items.why: Being unable to go is 去不了 (liǎo), with the object after the block. 不去 would say you choose not to.

items.src_py: wǒ men chī de liǎo zhè me duō cài
items.task: Make it negative (cannot manage).
items.zh: 我们吃不了这么多菜。
items.py: wǒ men chī bù liǎo zhè me duō cài
items.en: We can't eat this many dishes.
items.why: Negating V得了 means swapping 得 for 不: 吃不了, not 不吃了 or 没吃得了.

items.src_py: wǒ bù qù hǎi biān le
items.task: Say you caught a cold and are unable to go (not that you decided against it).
items.zh: 我感冒了，去不了海边了。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le qù bù liǎo hǎi biān le
items.en: I've caught a cold, so I can't go to the seaside any more.
items.why: 去不了 (liǎo) is inability; 不去了 (le) was a decision. The final 了 comes after the object.

items.src: 考试的时候，你可以看手机。
items.src_py: kǎo shì de shí hou nǐ kě yǐ kàn shǒu jī
items.task: Say it is not allowed.
items.zh: 考试的时候，你不能看手机。
items.py: kǎo shì de shí hou nǐ bù néng kàn shǒu jī
items.en: You can't look at your phone during the exam.
items.why: The opposite of permission 可以 is 不能 + verb; a rule is not a complement like 看不了.

items.src_py: yī shēng shuō nǐ kě yǐ chū yuàn le
items.task: Say the doctor says you are not allowed to leave hospital.
items.zh: 医生说你不能出院。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ bù néng chū yuàn
items.en: The doctor says you can't leave the hospital.
items.why: The doctor decides, so permission becomes 不能 + verb. 出不去 would say you are physically unable.

items.src_py: wǒ de tuǐ hěn hǎo wǒ zǒu de dòng
items.task: Say your leg hurts so much that you cannot walk any further.
items.zh: 我的腿太疼了，走不动了。
items.py: wǒ de tuǐ tài téng le zǒu bù dòng le
items.en: My leg hurts too much; I can't walk any further.
items.why: Pain is a physical obstacle, so 走不动: 得 becomes 不, and 了 marks the new situation at the end.

items.src_py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say his throat hurts, so he cannot sing well today.
items.zh: 他嗓子疼，今天唱不好。
items.py: tā sǎng zi téng jīn tiān chàng bù hǎo
items.en: His throat hurts; he can't sing well today.
items.why: The sore throat blocks the result, so the potential 唱不好 is used. 唱得很好 was a degree statement and 很 cannot stay.

items.src_py: tā xiě hàn zì xiě de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say he does not write them well.
items.zh: 他写汉字写得不好。
items.py: tā xiě hàn zì xiě de bù hǎo
items.en: He doesn't write Chinese characters well.
items.why: This judges how he writes, so the degree pattern 写得不好 is kept. The potential 写不好 would say he cannot manage it.

items.src: 这个问题我说得很清楚。
items.src_py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ shuō de hěn qīng chu
items.task: Say you cannot explain it clearly.
items.zh: 这个问题我说不清楚。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ shuō bù qīng chu
items.en: I can't explain this matter clearly.
items.why: Inability needs the potential 说不清楚; 得很 (degree) must be dropped, because 很 cannot sit inside a potential form.

items.src_py: zhè piān wén zhāng wǒ kàn dǒng le
items.task: Say you cannot understand it; put the object after the verb block.
items.zh: 我看不懂这篇文章。
items.py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè piān wén zhāng
items.en: I can't understand this article.
items.why: 看懂了 turns into 看不懂 with the 了 dropped, and the object follows the whole block.

items.src: 我看不懂这个药的说明。
items.src_py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè ge yào de shuō míng
items.task: Put the object first as the topic.
items.zh: 这个药的说明我看不懂。
items.py: zhè ge yào de shuō míng wǒ kàn bù dǒng
items.en: I can't understand the instructions for this medicine.
items.why: A long definite object is often fronted as a topic, leaving the block 看不懂 intact; 把 is not allowed here.

items.src: 老师的问题我回答不了。
items.src_py: lǎo shī de wèn tí wǒ huí dá bù liǎo
items.task: Move the object after the verb block.
items.zh: 我回答不了老师的问题。
items.py: wǒ huí dá bù liǎo lǎo shī de wèn tí
items.en: I can't answer the teacher's question.
items.why: 回答不了 stays whole and the object follows it; putting 老师的问题 between 回答 and 不了 would split the block.

items.src: 黑板上的字你看得清楚。
items.src_py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì nǐ kàn de qīng chu
items.task: Ask with the positive and negative forms side by side, no 吗.
items.zh: 黑板上的字你看得清楚看不清楚？
items.py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì nǐ kàn de qīng chu kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: Can you see the writing on the board clearly or not?
items.why: The full pair 看得清楚看不清楚 forms the question, and 吗 must not be added.

items.src_py: nǐ shuì de zháo
items.task: Ask with the colloquial V不V得R pattern.
items.zh: 你睡不睡得着？
items.py: nǐ shuì bù shuì de zháo
items.en: Can you fall asleep?
items.why: V不V得R repeats only the verb: 睡不睡得着. The complement 着 is not doubled.

items.src_py: wǒ men xiàn zài qù lái de jí
items.task: Ask with 吗.
items.zh: 我们现在去，来得及吗？
items.py: wǒ men xiàn zài qù lái de jí ma
items.en: If we go now, will we make it in time?
items.why: The positive 来得及 plus 吗 asks whether there is time. 来不及 is used for the negative answer.

items.src_py: xuě zhè me dà nǐ kāi de liǎo chē
items.task: Ask with 吗.
items.zh: 雪这么大，你开得了车吗？
items.py: xuě zhè me dà nǐ kāi de liǎo chē ma
items.en: The snow is so heavy; can you drive?
items.why: The positive 开得了 plus 吗 asks whether it is possible; the object 车 follows the block before 吗.

items.src: 这条路这么窄，大车开得过去。
items.src_py: zhè tiáo lù zhè me zhǎi dà chē kāi de guò qù
items.task: Ask with the positive and negative forms, no 吗.
items.zh: 这条路这么窄，大车开得过去开不过去？
items.py: zhè tiáo lù zhè me zhǎi dà chē kāi de guò qù kāi bù guò qù
items.en: This road is so narrow; can a big vehicle get through or not?
items.why: The pair 开得过去开不过去 asks the question; adding 吗 or doubling only 过去 would be wrong.

items.s: 雾太大了，我们不看见路。
items.s_py: wù tài dà le wǒ men bù kàn jiàn lù
items.zh: 雾太大了，我们看不见路。
items.py: wù tài dà le wǒ men kàn bù jiàn lù
items.en: The fog is too thick; we can't see the road.
items.why: Inability puts 不 between 看 and 见. 不看见 in front of the verb is not a potential form.

items.s: 昨天雨声太大，我一句也没听清楚。
items.s_py: zuó tiān yǔ shēng tài dà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng qīng chu
items.zh: 昨天雨声太大，我一句也没听清楚。
items.py: zuó tiān yǔ shēng tài dà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng qīng chu
items.en: The rain was so loud yesterday that I didn't catch a single sentence.
items.why: 昨天 and 一句也没 report a single finished occasion, so 没 + verb + result is right; the potential 听不清楚 would describe a general inability.

items.s: 我的眼镜坏了，什么都看不得清楚。
items.s_py: wǒ de yǎn jìng huài le shén me dōu kàn bù de qīng chu
items.zh: 我的眼镜坏了，什么都看不清楚。
items.py: wǒ de yǎn jìng huài le shén me dōu kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: My glasses are broken and I can't see anything clearly.
items.why: 得 and 不 are alternatives; they are never stacked between verb and result.

items.s: 他的名字我想起不来了。
items.s_py: tā de míng zi wǒ xiǎng qǐ bù lái le
items.zh: 他的名字我想不起来了。
items.py: tā de míng zi wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
items.en: I can't remember his name any more.
items.why: 不 goes right after the verb, before the whole direction word 起来. 想起不来 splits the direction word.

items.s: 雪太厚了，车开不出去。
items.s_py: xuě tài hòu le chē kāi bù chū qù
items.zh: 雪太厚了，车开不出去。
items.py: xuě tài hòu le chē kāi bù chū qù
items.en: The snow is so deep that the car can't get out.
items.why: Snow is a physical obstacle, so 开不出去 is right. 不能开出去 would sound like a ban.

items.s: 山太高了，我们爬没上去。
items.s_py: shān tài gāo le wǒ men pá méi shàng qù
items.zh: 山太高了，我们爬不上去。
items.py: shān tài gāo le wǒ men pá bù shàng qù
items.en: The mountain is too high; we can't climb up.
items.why: 没 goes before the verb (没爬上去). Inside the block it must be 不.

items.s: 这间教室坐得下六十个人。
items.s_py: zhè jiān jiào shì zuò de xià liù shí ge rén
items.zh: 这间教室坐得下六十个人。
items.py: zhè jiān jiào shì zuò de xià liù shí ge rén
items.en: This classroom can seat sixty people.
items.why: 得 + 下 states that there is room for that many; the positive form is normal for capacity statements.

items.s: 雨下得太大，我们来不及得回家。
items.s_py: yǔ xià de tài dà wǒ men lái bù jí de huí jiā
items.zh: 雨下得太大，我们来不及回家。
items.py: yǔ xià de tài dà wǒ men lái bù jí huí jiā
items.en: The rain is so heavy that we have no time to get home.
items.why: 来不及 is a fixed form followed directly by a verb; no 得 may be added after it.

items.s: 我感冒了，今天上不了班。
items.s_py: wǒ gǎn mào le jīn tiān shàng bù liǎo bān
items.zh: 我感冒了，今天上不了班。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le jīn tiān shàng bù liǎo bān
items.en: I have a cold and can't go to work today.
items.why: 上不了班 (liǎo) with the object after the block is correct; the cold is a practical obstacle, not a rule.

items.s: 这么多菜，我们吃不了完。
items.s_py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men chī bù liǎo wán
items.zh: 这么多菜，我们吃不了。
items.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men chī bù liǎo
items.en: There is too much food; we can't eat it all.
items.why: 吃不了 and 吃不完 are alternatives; 不了 is already the complement, so 完 cannot follow.

items.s: 那场大雪，我一辈子都忘不了。
items.s_py: nà chǎng dà xuě wǒ yī bèi zi dōu wàng bù liǎo
items.zh: 那场大雪，我一辈子都忘不了。
items.py: nà chǎng dà xuě wǒ yī bèi zi dōu wàng bù liǎo
items.en: I'll never forget that heavy snowfall.
items.why: 忘不了 (liǎo) is the normal way to say cannot forget; the object is fronted as a topic.

items.s: 你感冒了，不能喝冰水。
items.s_py: nǐ gǎn mào le bù néng hē bīng shuǐ
items.zh: 你感冒了，不能喝冰水。
items.py: nǐ gǎn mào le bù néng hē bīng shuǐ
items.en: You have a cold, so you shouldn't drink iced water.
items.why: This is advice about what to avoid, so 不能 + verb is right; there is no complement to use.

items.s: 他的汉字写不很好。
items.s_py: tā de hàn zì xiě bù hěn hǎo
items.zh: 他的汉字写得很好。
items.py: tā de hàn zì xiě de hěn hǎo
items.en: He writes Chinese characters very well.
items.why: 很 belongs to the degree pattern with 得; it cannot follow the potential 不 in 写不很好.

items.s: 医生说得不清楚，所以我没听懂。
items.s_py: yī shēng shuō de bù qīng chu suǒ yǐ wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.zh: 医生说得不清楚，所以我没听懂。
items.py: yī shēng shuō de bù qīng chu suǒ yǐ wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: The doctor didn't explain clearly, so I didn't understand.
items.why: 说得不清楚 judges how he spoke (degree 得), and 没听懂 reports the outcome once; both are correct together.

items.s: 这个药名太长，我把它记不住。
items.s_py: zhè ge yào míng tài cháng wǒ bǎ tā jì bù zhù
items.zh: 这个药名太长，我记不住。
items.py: zhè ge yào míng tài cháng wǒ jì bù zhù
items.en: This medicine name is too long; I can't remember it.
items.why: 把 cannot be used with a potential complement; the object stays as a topic or follows 记不住.

items.s: 雪这么厚，你们走不走得回去？
items.s_py: xuě zhè me hòu nǐ men zǒu bù zǒu de huí qù
items.zh: 雪这么厚，你们走不走得回去？
items.py: xuě zhè me hòu nǐ men zǒu bù zǒu de huí qù
items.en: The snow is so deep; can you walk back?
items.why: V不V得R is the correct colloquial question; no 吗 is added.

items.q: 球场的灯太暗了，我看___见球。
items.zh: 球场的灯太暗了，我看不见球。
items.en: The lights on the pitch are too dim; I can't see the ball.
items.why: 太暗 is the reason the result fails, so 不 goes between 看 and 见: 看不见. 得 would claim I can see it, which the cue contradicts, and 没 cannot sit inside verb + result.
items.py: qiú chǎng de dēng tài àn le wǒ kàn bù jiàn qiú

items.task: Make it negative (I have no room for it).
items.zh: 我吃不下这碗面。
items.en: I can't eat this bowl of noodles.
items.why: Replace 得 with 不 to get 吃不下 'no room for it'. Do not use 不 before the verb or 没.
items.py: wǒ chī bù xià zhè wǎn miàn
items.src_py: wǒ chī de xià zhè wǎn miàn

items.s: 球场太吵了，我不听见你说话。
items.zh: 球场太吵了，我听不见你说话。
items.en: The pitch is so noisy that I can't hear you.
items.why: 不 must go between 听 and 见 to say cannot hear. 不听见 puts it before the verb.
items.s_py: qiú chǎng tài chǎo le wǒ bù tīng jiàn nǐ shuō huà
items.py: qiú chǎng tài chǎo le wǒ tīng bù jiàn nǐ shuō huà

items.zh: 我们买不到票。
items.en: We can't get tickets.
items.why: 买不到 is one block and the object follows it, or goes to the front as a topic. Nothing can split 买不 from 到.
items.py: wǒ men mǎi bù dào piào

items.q: 我找了半天，还是___不到那家球店。
items.zh: 我找了半天，还是找不到那家球店。
items.en: I've looked for ages and still can't find that sports shop.
items.why: 找了半天 shows the action is searching, so 找不到 'cannot find'. 买不到 would mean I cannot buy it, and 说不到 is not a word.
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shì zhǎo bù dào nà jiā qiú diàn

items.zh: 你找得到那家店吗？
items.en: Can you find that shop?
items.why: 找得到 replaces 能找到, and 吗 closes the question. Adding 不 inside would form a different question.

items.q: 周末的比赛票卖光了，我们买___到了。
items.zh: 周末的比赛票卖光了，我们买不到了。
items.en: The tickets for the weekend match are sold out; we can't get any now.
items.why: 卖光了 means the result is out of reach now, so 不 goes between 买 and 到: 买不到. 没 would have to come before 买 (没买到), and 别 is an imperative.

items.s: 比赛的声音太小，我没听得见。
items.zh: 比赛的声音太小，我听不见。
items.en: The match audio is too quiet; I can't hear it.
items.why: 没 cannot be put in front of a potential form 听得见. Say 听不见 for cannot hear.

items.q: 跑了十公里，我已经跑___动了。
items.zh: 跑了十公里，我已经跑不动了。
items.en: After running ten kilometres, I can't run any more.
items.why: 已经 ... 了 describes my present state with no strength left, so 跑不动. 得 would say I am still able to, and 没 cannot go inside the complement.

items.q: 站牌上的字太小了，我看不___。
items.zh: 站牌上的字太小了，我看不清楚。
items.en: The writing on the stop sign is too small; I can't see it clearly.
items.why: Small writing leads to 看不清楚, 'cannot see clearly'. 干净 and 开心 are not results of looking at text.

items.s: 这么贵的球鞋，我不能买起。
items.zh: 这么贵的球鞋，我买不起。
items.en: I can't afford such expensive sneakers.
items.why: 'Cannot afford' is the set form 买不起. 不能 cannot be added in front of 买起.

items.py: zhè me guì de qiú xié wǒ mǎi bù qǐ

items.zh: 他看不懂地图。
items.en: He can't read the map.
items.why: 看不懂 stays together and the object follows it. 看地图不懂 splits the block, which is wrong.

items.q: 刚才教练讲的动作，我没听___。
items.zh: 刚才教练讲的动作，我没听懂。
items.en: I didn't understand the move the coach just explained.
items.why: 刚才 marks one past occasion, so the negative is 没 + verb + result: 没听懂. 听得 and 听不 after 没 would put 没 in front of a potential form, which is never allowed.

items.task: Say you cannot finish them.
items.zh: 这些菜我们吃不完。
items.en: We can't finish all these dishes.
items.why: Put 不 between 吃 and 完: 吃不完 'cannot finish'. 了 is dropped.

items.en: The rules of this game are too complicated; however I try, I can't learn them.

items.en: This bicycle is too expensive; I can't afford it.

items.q: 要是你说慢一点，再配上字幕，我应该就听___懂。
items.zh: 要是你说慢一点，再配上字幕，我应该就听得懂。

items.q: 我们想爬到山顶，可是山太陡了，爬不___去。

items.en: We want to climb to the summit, but the hill is too steep to get up.

items.why: 太重了 is a physical reason, so 拿不动 'cannot lift it'. 不能拿走 means you are not allowed to take it away.

items.zh: 她想不起来体育馆在哪儿。
items.en: She can't remember where the gym is.
items.why: 想不起来 is the potential 'cannot recall'. It replaces 没想起来 and the question clause follows.

items.q: 医生说我的腿还没好，我现在___。
items.zh: 医生说我的腿还没好，我现在不能跑步。
items.en: The doctor says my leg hasn't healed yet, so I'm not allowed to run now.
items.why: The doctor's instruction is the reason, so 不能跑步 'must not'. 跑不动 would be about having no strength to run.

items.q: 这个动作太难了，我怎么练也做___好。
items.zh: 这个动作太难了，我怎么练也做不好。
items.en: This move is too hard; however much I practise, I can't do it well.
items.why: 怎么练也 means repeated failure, so the potential 做不好. 做得好 would claim success, and 很 cannot go inside a potential form.

items.task: Say you did not find it just now (past occasion, not ability).
items.zh: 我刚才没找到那家店。
items.en: I didn't find that shop just now.
items.why: A single past event is 没 + 找到. 找不到 would describe being unable in general.

items.q: 他篮球打___很好，是学校队的。
items.zh: 他篮球打得很好，是学校队的。
items.en: He plays basketball very well; he is on the school team.
items.why: Describing how well someone does something takes 打得很好, with 很 after 得. 不 would turn it into 'cannot'.

items.q: 我不是不努力，可是这首歌太难，我就是唱___好。
items.zh: 我不是不努力，可是这首歌太难，我就是唱不好。
items.en: It's not that I don't try; the song is just too hard and I simply can't sing it well.
items.why: The context is failing despite effort, so 唱不好 'cannot sing it well'. 唱得好 would claim I can, and 唱很好 is not a form.

items.zh: 这么多东西，我一个人拿不了。
items.en: I can't carry this many things by myself.
items.why: The potential form takes only one complement. 拿不了 or 拿不动 is right, not both stacked together.

items.zh: 这个新地铁站的名字，我记不住。
items.en: I can't remember the name of this new metro station.
items.why: A potential complement cannot be used with 把, because 把 needs something actually done to the object. Front the object as a topic instead.

items.q: 球场上太吵，你听___听得见我说话？
items.zh: 球场上太吵，你听不听得见我说话？
items.en: It's so noisy on the pitch; can you hear what I'm saying?
items.why: The colloquial question repeats the verb as V不V得R: 听不听得见. 没 and 别 cannot make this question.
